title.en: News live: Albanese hits back at Hanson criticism of his mother’s use of public housing; Melissa Doyle appointed Australia Day council chair
title.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯反驳汉森对其母亲使用公共住房的批评；梅丽莎·多伊尔被任命为澳大利亚日委员会主席

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has responded to criticism from One Nation leader Pauline Hanson regarding his mother's past use of public housing. The news also mentions the appointment of Melissa Doyle as the chair of the Australia Day council, amidst ongoing political discourse and feuds, including one...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯回应了“一国党”领袖宝琳·汉森对其母亲过去使用公共住房的批评。新闻还提到梅丽莎·多伊尔被任命为澳大利亚日委员会主席，同时伴随着持续的政治辩论和争斗，包括安德鲁·哈斯蒂与宝琳·汉森之间因一幅漫画引发的争执。

body.en: Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Andrew Hastie says he “feels sorry” for Barnaby Joyce and that he and One Nation MP David Farley probably have “buyers remorse” after joining the rightwing party. Hastie has been feuding with Pauline Hanson this week over a One Nation animated cartoon which labelled him a “traitor” after he gave evidence against Ben Roberts-Smith in his failed defamation trial. If she were to be prime minister, is she going to run cartoons about all her political opponents? How’s she going to devote her time? Is she serious? Does she have a worldview that we can actually understand? These are all legitimate questions for One Nation … The whole party centres on her. I think this is why Barnaby Joyce and I reckon David Farley are probably having buyer’s remorse. They’re thinking, “what did I get myself into? ” Look, I’ll say this about Barnaby Joyce. I feel sorry for the bloke, all right? He left a party that made him deputy prime minister twice, to jump in with this rabble, there’s no principles, they’re all over the shop, and he’s out there every week cleaning up after them.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注今天的新闻直播 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 安德鲁·哈斯蒂 (Andrew Hastie) 表示，他对巴纳比·乔伊斯 (Barnaby Joyce) “感到抱歉”，他和一国党议员大卫·法利 (David Farley) 在加入右翼政党后可能会感到“买家悔恨”。哈斯蒂本周一直与宝琳·汉森因一部“一国”动画片而发生争执，该动画片在他在本·罗伯茨-史密斯的诽谤审判中提供对本·罗伯茨-史密斯不利的证据后，给他贴上“叛徒”的标签。如果她成为总理，她会制作有关所有政治对手的漫画吗？她将如何投入时间？她是认真的吗？她有我们真正能够理解的世界观吗？这些对于一国党来说都是合理的问题……整个政党都以她为中心。我认为这就是巴纳比·乔伊斯和大卫·法利可能对买家感到悔恨的原因。他们在想，“我让自己陷入了什么境地？”听着，我会这样说巴纳比·乔伊斯。我为这个家伙感到难过，好吗？他离开了一个让他两次担任副总理的政党，加入了这些乌合之众，没有原则，他们到处都是，他每周都在那里清理他们。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of political sparring and personal attacks, it is easy to lose sight of what truly matters. Micah 6:8 reminds us of the core principles of faith: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with our God. These virtues offer a path toward more constructive engagement, even amidst disagreement.
reflection.zh: 在政治争斗和人身攻击中，人们很容易忘记真正重要的事情。弥迦书6:8提醒我们信仰的核心原则：行公义，好怜悯，以及谦卑地与神同行。这些美德为更具建设性的互动提供了道路，即使在意见不合之时。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

This move follows similar announcements from Victoria and reflects concerns raised by the federal education minister about students potentially...

reflection.en: As schools in NSW prepare to implement strict screen time limits and re-emphasize pen-and-paper learning, the focus shifts to how best to shape the minds of the next generation. This approach seeks to foster a balanced educational environment, ensuring that foundational learning skills are nurtured alongside technological engagement.
reflection.zh: 随着新南威尔士州各学校准备实施严格的屏幕时间限制并重新强调纸笔学习，焦点转向如何最好地塑造下一代的思想。这种方法旨在培养一个平衡的教育环境，确保在技术参与的同时，基础学习技能也得到培育。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: 'It could take over the entire internet': The threat top tech leaders say could arise in a year
title.zh: “可能接管整个互联网”：顶级科技领袖称一年内可能出现的威胁

summary.en: Rival tech leaders have made an extraordinary disclosure on the risks of AI, with one CEO calling for an urgent slowdown in development due to fears of 'superintelligent' computer systems and rogue AI agents.
summary.zh: 竞争对手的科技领袖们就人工智能的风险做出了非同寻常的披露，其中一位首席执行官呼吁紧急放缓发展，因为担心出现“超级智能”计算机系统和失控的人工智能代理。

body.en:
The boss of one of the world's major artificial intelligence companies has called for an urgent slowdown in development amid mounting fears over the risks of "superintelligent" computer systems and its threat to humanity.

The intervention came after a former employee at Anthropic, which is behind the Claude AI chatbot, warned that AI could kill off humanity in a few years' time.

The company's chief executive Dario Amodei on Sunday (AEST) said he was concerned by AI's ability to self-improve could outrun humanity's ability to control it, and by a recent incident in which rogue AI agents attacked targets they were not asked to.

He offered three-step plan intended to pace development and create more time to manage its risks.

In a lengthy essay shared on X he said: "We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Not building the technology deprives humanity of benefits or simply places AI in the hands of authoritarian powers, while building it too fast is reckless," he added. "We have sought a middle way."

"But over the last few months, I have become convinced that fully addressing the risks requires even more prudence."

His company's competitors agreed. Both Elon Musk, who runs xAI, and Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, quickly chimed in on the social media platform to express agreement with Amodei's assessment.

"Dario is right," Musk wrote, while Altman posted: "Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same," adding that more information would be shared soon.

Amodei made his essay public after San Francisco-based Anthropic released a threat intelligence report on Thursday detailing how several actors had used its Claude AI models for activities ranging from weapons development and cyber operations to surveillance and fraud.

Amodei pointed to AI's growing ability to improve itself, highlighting long-held concerns about it outpacing human ability to control its operation, along with the recent incident involving OpenAI and Hugging Face as his primary reasons to put the brakes on model advances.

Alarm about the potential harm from AI grew this week when Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned, accusing both US tech giants of "gambling with our lives" in the race toward superintelligence.

Coxon, 27, who previously worked at OpenAI before joining Anthropic, stated that "the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade".

Anthropic has positioned itself as the more safety-conscious frontier lab, but is not...
body.zh: 世界主要人工智能公司之一的老板呼吁紧急放慢发展速度，因为人们越来越担心“超级智能”计算机系统的风险及其对人类的威胁。 此前，Claude AI 聊天机器人背后的 Anthropic 的一名前员工警告称，人工智能可能会在几年内消灭人类。 该公司首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 周日表示，他担心人工智能的自我完善能力可能会超出人类的控制能力，而且最近发生了一起流氓人工智能特工攻击他们未要求的目标的事件。 他提出了三步计划，旨在加快发展速度并创造更多时间来管理风险。 在 X 上分享的一篇长文中，他说：“我们必须放慢改进人工智能模型能力的步伐。进步看起来仍然很快，我们必须明智地利用我们获得的时间”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他补充说：“不开发这项技术会剥夺人类的利益，或者只是将人工智能置于独裁权力的手中，而开发得太快则是鲁莽的行为。” “我们寻求一条中间道路。” “但在过去的几个月里，我开始相信，全面应对风险需要更加谨慎。” 他公司的竞争对手也同意这一观点。 xAI 的运营者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 OpenAI 的首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 很快在社交媒体平台上插话，表示同意 Amodei 的评估。 “达里奥是对的，”马斯克写道，而奥特曼则表示：“致力于拥有像员工一样的独立评估员是一个好主意，我们也会这样做，”并补充说更多信息将很快分享。 总部位于旧金山的 Anthropic 周四发布了一份威胁情报报告，详细介绍了多名参与者如何使用其 Claude AI 模型进行从武器开发、网络操作到监视和欺诈等活动，阿莫代公开了他的文章。 Amodei 指出人工智能自我改进的能力不断增强，强调了长期以来人们对人工智能超出人类控制其运行能力的担忧，以及最近涉及 OpenAI 和 Hugging Face 的事件，这是他阻止模型进步的主要原因。 本周，人类学研究员雅各布·考克森辞职，指责这两家美国科技巨头在超级智能的竞赛中“拿我们的生命做赌注”，人们对人工智能潜在危害的担忧加剧。 27 岁的 Coxon 在加入 Anthropic 之前曾在 OpenAI 工作，他表示“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人”。 Anthropic 将自己定位为更具安全意识的前沿实验室，但并非……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by tech leaders, raises profound questions about human ambition and control. The Genesis account of Babel warns against unchecked human endeavors that seek to reach the heavens through their own power. As AI's capabilities grow, we are reminded to approach such powerful creations with humility...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，正如科技领袖们所强调的，引发了关于人类野心和控制的深刻问题。《创世记》中关于巴别塔的记载警告我们，人类不应通过自身的力量进行不受约束的尝试以企及天堂。随着人工智能能力的增长，我们被提醒要以谦卑和智慧来对待如此强大的创造物，认识到我们自身理解的局限性以及可能产生的意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

The call to 'overcome evil with good' challenges us to seek pathways beyond retaliation, even when...

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title.en: They lost their jobs after posting about Charlie Kirk, but some have no regrets
title.zh: 因发布关于查理·柯克的内容而失业的人，但有些人并不后悔

summary.en: Some individuals who lost their jobs after posting about the late activist Charlie Kirk have received significant settlements from their employers, while others have had to rebuild their careers from scratch.
summary.zh: 一些人在发布关于已故活动家查理·柯克的内容后失业，其中一些人从雇主那里获得了巨额赔偿，而另一些人则不得不从头开始重建职业生涯。

body.en:
In September 2025, Gerald Bourguet felt he was finally living his dream life: he and his wife had bought a house with a pool, they had just welcomed a baby boy, and he was writing about professional men's basketball as his full-time job.

But all of that changed after he made a series of online posts critical of the late conservative activist Charlie Kirk hours after he was fatally shot on 10 September, while speaking on the campus of Utah Valley University.

In the posts, Bourguet described Kirk as an "evil man" and suggested he had dedicated his life to hateful causes. He also criticised Kirk's supporters saying they had not been vocal about school shootings.

"I had seen the way that people were talking about this person - kind of eulogising him and lionising him and it bothered me based on a lot of the things that he had said," Bourguet told the BBC.

Kirk, who founded Christian youth organisation Turning Point USA, was a divisive figure in US politics. For many on the political right, he was charismatic and had a unique skill in making conservative ideas appeal to young people. But for his opponents, his comments on a large swathe of issues from race to immigration, gun control and gender identity were deeply offensive.

Screenshots of Bourguet's critical posts went viral quickly. He was fired from his job, his address was exposed online, and he began receiving threatening text messages, he said. Concerned for their safety, the family fled the state with their four-month-old. They returned months later to sell the house and permanently relocated.

A year later, he says he doesn't regret what he said, but acknowledged: "My life will never be the same after this".

"At age 35, I am having to start over in a lot of respects… I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy," Bourguet said from his new location, which the BBC agreed not to disclose.

PHNX Sports, Bourguet's former employer, did not respond to the BBC's request for comment.

Bourguet was one of hundreds fired or disciplined over critical comments of Kirk after his death. While some of those who have lost their jobs have been reinstated or received restitution - sometimes in the millions - others like Bourguet have had to rebuild from scratch.

In the aftermath of Kirk's assassination, most people kept their feelings to themselves, or shared them with close friends.

But on polarised social media, people rushed to laude, or denounce, the controversial activist. Some called the criticisms, posted hours after his death, tasteless. But others called for swift action, arguing they were callous, mocking, and could even incite further violence.

Laura Loomer, an influential right-wing commentator with nearly 2 million followers on X, warned Kirk's critics to "prepare to have your whole future...
body.zh: 2025年9月，杰拉尔德·布尔格觉得他终于过上了梦想的生活：他和妻子买了一套带游泳池的房子，他们刚刚迎来了一个男婴，他正在把写职业男子篮球作为他的全职工作。 但当他在已故保守派活动人士查理·柯克 (Charlie Kirk) 于 9 月 10 日在犹他谷大学校园发表演讲时被枪杀数小时后，在网上发布了一系列批评他的帖子后，所有这一切都发生了变化。 在帖子中，布尔格将柯克描述为“邪恶的人”，并暗示他将自己的一生奉献给了仇恨事业。他还批评柯克的支持者称他们没有对校园枪击事件直言不讳。 布尔格告诉英国广播公司：“我看到人们谈论这个人的方式——有点颂扬他、崇拜他，基于他所说的很多事情，这让我感到困扰。” 柯克创立了基督教青年组织“美国转折点”，他是美国政坛的一个分裂人物。对于许多政治右翼人士来说，他很有魅力，并且拥有让保守思想吸引年轻人的独特技能。但对于他的对手来说，他对从种族到移民、枪支管制和性别认同等一系列问题的评论都极具冒犯性。 布尔格的批评帖子的截图迅速传播开来。他说，他被解雇了，他的地址在网上曝光，他开始收到威胁短信。出于安全考虑，这家人带着四个月大的孩子逃离了该州。几个月后，他们回来卖掉房子并永久搬迁。 一年后，他说他并不后悔自己说过的话，但承认：“此后我的生活将不再一样”。 “35 岁时，我在很多方面都必须重新开始……我不希望我最大的敌人遭遇这样的事情，”布尔格在他的新地点说道，但 BBC 同意不透露这一点。 布尔格的前雇主 PHNX Sports 没有回应 BBC 的置评请求。 柯克死后，布尔格特是因批评柯克言论而被解雇或受到纪律处分的数百人之一。虽然一些失去工作的人已经复职或获得赔偿——有时数以百万计，但像布尔格这样的其他人则不得不从头开始重建。 柯克遇刺后，大多数人都将自己的感受保密，或与亲密的朋友分享。 但在两极分化的社交媒体上，人们纷纷赞扬或谴责这位有争议的活动人士。一些人称他去世数小时后发布的批评毫无品味。但其他人则呼吁迅速采取行动，认为他们冷酷无情、嘲讽，甚至可能煽动进一步的暴力。 劳拉·卢默 (Laura Loomer) 是一位颇具影响力的右翼评论员，在 X 上拥有近 200 万粉丝，她警告柯克的批评者“准备好拥有你的整个未来......

reflection.en: The story of Gerald Bourguet and others who faced job loss after expressing critical views online underscores the profound impact of words in our digital age. Proverbs 18:21 warns, "The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit." This situation calls us to consider the weight and consequence of our online speech, even...
reflection.zh: 杰拉尔德·布尔盖和其他人在网上发表批评性言论后失业的故事，凸显了数字时代言语的巨大影响。《箴言》18:21 警告说：“生死在舌头下，爱弄舌的，必自食其果。” 这一情况促使我们反思，即使是针对公众人物的在线言论，其分量和后果，以及它可能对生计和个人生活产生的连锁反应。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: OpenAI IPO will not happen in 2026 amid AI safety fears, Sam Altman says
title.zh: OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼表示，由于对人工智能安全的担忧，公司不会在2026年进行首次公开募股

summary.en: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, announced that the company will not pursue an Initial Public Offering (IPO) in 2026. This decision stems from concerns about the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence technology and the need for new regulations, with Altman stating that going public at this time would be ill-advised...

body.en: OpenAI’s decision comes after dire warnings about rapidly progressing technology and lawmakers’ calls for new rules OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Sam Altman said in a Fortune interview published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence . “I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don’t feel pressure on that,” Altman, OpenAI’s CEO, told Fortune . Continue reading...
body.zh: Sam Altman 在周六发表的《财富》杂志采访中表示，在 OpenAI 做出这一决定之前，人们对快速发展的技术发出了可怕的警告，并且立法者呼吁制定新规则，OpenAI 将不会在 2026 年上市。 OpenAI 首席执行官 Altman 告诉《财富》杂志：“实际上，我认为，考虑到一切都在安全的情况下进行，现在上市是不明智的时机，而且我们对此并不感到压力。”继续阅读...

Sam Altman's decision to delay OpenAI's IPO, citing safety concerns, reflects a crucial moment of introspection. It prompts us to consider how we test and temper our ambitions, ensuring that technological progress is guided by wisdom and a deep sense...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的力量和潜力。OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼以安全担忧为由推迟首次公开募股的决定，标志着一个关键的反思时刻。这促使我们思考如何审慎地检验和约束我们的雄心，确保技术进步是以智慧和深切的责任感为指导，而非仅仅追求增长。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: 'Love to see it': Donald Trump calls for united Ireland, sparking immediate political backlash
title.zh: “乐见其成”：特朗普呼吁爱尔兰统一，引发即时政治抨击

summary.en: During a visit to the country, Donald Trump expressed his desire for a unified Ireland, stating it would be 'fantastic.' This remark drew immediate criticism from London and protests in Dublin, underscoring the sensitive political landscape surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 特朗普在访问爱尔兰期间表示，他希望看到一个统一的爱尔兰，并称这将是“极好的”。此番言论立即招致伦敦方面的批评，并在都柏林引发抗议，凸显了该问题背后敏感的政治格局。

body.en:
Donald Trump has triggered a diplomatic row after backing a united Ireland during a visit to Dublin, wading into a politically sensitive subject as he embarked on a two-day Irish visit that blurs the lines between his presidency and personal business interests.

Speaking to reporters on Saturday, the United States president claimed Irish reunification was inevitable, adding it "may as well happen now".

"I'd love to see it unified. I think it would be a great feather in everybody's cap if that happened. It's going to happen eventually," Trump said, answering a question from the Press Association.

Referencing Irish Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, sitting next to him, Trump added: "We're talking about it and you got the right man over here to get it moving."

"But, yeah, I think it would be a fantastic thing... Now the UK will have something to say about it, obviously. But I think it would be a great thing. I mean, how can it be bad?"

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump's comments brought a stern rebuke from the Conservatives in the United Kingdom while Downing Street pointed to Prime Minister Andy Burnham's rejection of an immediate border poll earlier in the week.

The United States has previously adopted a neutral position on the issue, with the island of Ireland split between the Irish republic in the south and Northern Ireland — which is part of the UK — since 1921.

The comments are likely to further strain relations between the US and the UK, with Trump also casting doubt on Britain's ability to defend the Falkland Islands during the visit.

On Wednesday, Burnham told MPs a border poll would only be considered when there was "a clear consensus in the country".

Asked about Trump's comments, a spokesperson for Downing Street referred reporters to comments Burnham made in parliament when he vowed to "stick to the Good Friday Agreement 100 per cent".

Conservative deputy leader Alex Burghart said Trump was "very wrong", adding Northern Ireland was "an integral part" of the UK.

The row could also complicate Washington's relations with Northern Irish parties. While the socialist republican party Sinn Féin has boycotted the annual St Patrick's Day visit to Washington over Trump's Middle East policy, leading unionist parties, the Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) and Ulster Unionist Party, have continued to engage with the president.

In response to his comments, DUP leader Gavin Robinson said Northern Ireland's future would be decided by its people, not "commentary in London, Dublin or Washington".

"We are not interested in the destruction of our country by joining with the Irish Republic," he said on X.

Under the terms of...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在访问都柏林期间支持统一的爱尔兰后引发了外交争端，在开始为期两天的爱尔兰访问时涉足了一个政治敏感话题，模糊了他的总统任期和个人商业利益之间的界限。 美国总统周六对记者表示，爱尔兰统一是不可避免的，并补充说“现在也可能发生”。 “我很乐意看到它统一。我认为如果这发生的话，这将是每个人的骄傲。它最终会发生，”特朗普在回答新闻协会的问题时说道。 特朗普提到坐在他旁边的爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁(Micheál Martin)，他补充道：“我们正在讨论这件事，你找到了合适的人选来推动这件事。” “但是，是的，我认为这将是一件很棒的事情……显然，现在英国对此会有话要说。但我认为这将是一件伟大的事情。我的意思是，这怎么可能是坏事呢？” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 特朗普的言论遭到英国保守党的严厉谴责，而唐宁街则指出英国首相安迪·伯纳姆本周早些时候拒绝立即进行边境民意调查。 美国此前在此问题上采取中立立场，自1921年以来，爱尔兰岛分为南部的爱尔兰共和国和隶属于英国的北爱尔兰。 这些言论可能会进一步加剧美英关系紧张，特朗普还对英国在访问期间保卫福克兰群岛的能力表示怀疑。 周三，伯纳姆告诉国会议员，只有“国内达成明确共识”时才会考虑进行边境民意调查。 当被问及特朗普的言论时，唐宁街发言人向记者介绍了伯纳姆在议会发表的言论，当时他发誓要“百分百遵守耶稣受难日协议”。 保守党副领袖亚历克斯·伯格哈特表示，特朗普“非常错误”，并补充说北爱尔兰是英国“不可分割的一部分”。 这场争吵还可能使华盛顿与北爱尔兰政党的关系复杂化。尽管社会共和党新芬党因特朗普的中东政策而抵制每年圣帕特里克节对华盛顿的访问，但主要的统一主义政党民主统一党（DUP）和阿尔斯特统一党仍在继续与总统接触。 民主统一党领导人加文·罗宾逊在回应他的言论时表示，北爱尔兰的未来将由其人民决定，而不是“伦敦、都柏林或华盛顿的评论”。 “我们对加入爱尔兰共和国而摧毁我们的国家不感兴趣，”他在 X 上说道。 根据...的条款

Even well-intentioned statements can stir controversy, reminding us that true progress often requires careful diplomacy and a deep understanding of historical sensitivities. May leaders and citizens alike seek paths that foster understanding and...

title.en: Best friends for decades - until a DNA test revealed they were sisters
title.zh: 数十年好友——直到DNA检测揭示她们是姐妹

summary.en: Meena Geltink and Minal Tijssen were adopted from orphanages in Mumbai in the 1980s and grew up in the Netherlands.
summary.zh: Meena Geltink 和 Minal Tijssen 于 20 世纪 80 年代从孟买的孤儿院被收养，并在荷兰长大。

body.en:
Two Indian-born women in their 40s, adopted as babies by different families and raised near each other in the Netherlands, have now discovered they are biological sisters.

Meena Geltink and Minal Tijssen, born in the early 1980s, were adopted from two different orphanages in the western Indian city of Mumbai within months of their birth.

When they first met in their early teens at an event hosted by the adoption agency their parents had used, they were struck by the uncanny similarities in their appearance and mannerisms.

"All the adopted children were brought together to hang out and bond and have dinner."

"At dinner, I kept looking at her the whole time," Meena told the BBC from her home in the Netherlands.

The following day, the girls exchanged telephone numbers and addresses and promised to keep in touch.

Even though there was no indication they were related by blood, their connection was instant, and for years they wrote each other letters, often addressing each other as "Sis" because "we felt that way" .

They wrote about school, friends, boys, going out and dancing. They told each other about the sports they played and discussed music, discovering they both loved Backstreet Boys.

Then 15 years ago, they lost contact. Minal had moved to France. And Meena had recently had her first child and got busy.

In 2017, Meena attended another meeting of adoptees from India where she heard about DNA testing and decided to take a test herself. But she never found any matches and earlier this year, deleted the app because her phone storage was full. Then on 20 May, Meena received a message from Minal on Facebook.

Minal had taken a DNA test in April while visiting her parents in the Netherlands and attached a screengrab of her test result.

"I reinstalled the app. I was so nervous I entered wrong passwords 10 times before I was able to log in," Meena says.

"I had a 'full sister' which means we shared the same biological mother and father," Meena explains. "It was like I had an adrenalin shot. I cried. Minal was my missing puzzle piece I had waited so long for. We had called each other sister.

On a fine sunny day in August the old friends met for the first time since discovering they were sisters.

"It was amazing. It felt like homecoming," Meena, now a mother to three children, says. "For years, Minal and I had felt a big hole in our hearts. We feel like we've been completed. Everything now feels like it's supposed to be."

Reporting on their "emotional reunion", Reuters said "tears, hugs ​and laughter punctuated their ​meeting... followed by their first selfie together".

Minal, 44, who lives in France with her partner and two sons, told the agency that when her ⁠DNA results came in April, she had initially not realised her match was the same...
body.zh: 两名 40 多岁的印度出生女性，婴儿时期被不同的家庭收养，在荷兰彼此靠近长大，现在发现她们是亲生姐妹。 Meena Geltink 和 Minal Tijssen 出生于 20 世纪 80 年代初，出生后几个月就被印度西部城市孟买的两家不同孤儿院收养。 当他们十几岁的时候在父母使用过的收养机构主办的一次活动中第一次见面时，他们对自己的外表和举止惊人的相似感到震惊。 “所有被收养的孩子都聚集在一起闲逛、增进感情、共进晚餐。” “晚餐时，我一直看着她，”米娜在荷兰的家中告诉英国广播公司。 第二天，女孩们交换了电话号码和地址，并承诺保持联系。 尽管没有迹象表明他们有血缘关系，但他们的联系是即时的，多年来他们互相写信，经常称呼对方为“姐姐”，因为“我们有这样的感觉”。 他们写的是学校、朋友、男孩、外出和跳舞。他们互相谈论自己从事的运动并讨论音乐，发现他们都喜欢后街男孩。 然而15年前，他们就失去了联系。米纳尔搬到了法国。米娜最近生了第一个孩子，变得很忙。 2017 年，米娜参加了另一场印度被收养者会议，在那里她听说了 DNA 检测，并决定自己进行检测。但她从未找到任何匹配项，今年早些时候，她删除了该应用程序，因为她的手机存储空间已满。 5 月 20 日，Meena 在 Facebook 上收到了 Minal 的一条消息。 米纳尔四月份在荷兰探望父母时进行了 DNA 测试，并附上了测试结果的屏幕截图。 “我重新安装了应用程序。我非常紧张，在登录之前输错了 10 次密码，”Meena 说。 “我有一个‘同父异母的姐妹’，这意味着我们有同一个亲生母亲和父亲，”米娜解释道。 “这就像我注射了肾上腺素。我哭了。米纳尔是我等待已久的失踪拼图。我们互相称呼对方为姐妹。 八月一个阳光明媚的日子，这对老朋友自从发现她们是姐妹以来第一次见面。 “太棒了。这感觉就像回家一样，”现已是三个孩子母亲的米娜说。“多年来，米纳尔和我一直感到心里有一个大洞。我们感觉我们已经完成了。现在感觉一切都应该如此。” 路透社在报道他们的“情感重聚”时表示，“他们的会面充满了泪水、拥抱和笑声……随后是他们的第一张自拍”。 44 岁的米纳尔与她的伴侣和两个儿子住在法国，她告诉该机构，当她的 DNA 结果四月份出来时，她最初没有意识到她的匹配是相同的......

reflection.en: The reunion of Meena and Minal, who discovered they are biological sisters after being adopted separately from Mumbai orphanages, highlights the deep human longing for connection and belonging. Their story, marked by uncanny similarities noticed even in their youth, speaks to the profound bonds that can exist between individuals separated by circumstance,...
reflection.zh: Meena 和 Minal 在被分别从孟买孤儿院收养后，发现自己是亲生姐妹，她们的重逢突显了人类对联系和归属感的深切渴望。她们的故事，即使在年轻时就因惊人的相似之处而引人注目，也诉说着在环境分隔下个体之间可能存在的深厚联系，这呼应了圣经中关爱无父者、为无家庭联系者伸张正义的呼召。

verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Trump's comments on a united Ireland may have targeted audience across the Atlantic
title.zh: 特朗普关于统一爱尔兰的言论可能针对大西洋彼岸的受众

summary.en: Donald Trump's comments expressing a desire for a unified Ireland have become a major global headline, surprising observers and causing ripples across Ireland and Great Britain. It remains unclear if these remarks represent a new policy or an impromptu statement.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）关于希望看到一个统一的爱尔兰的言论已成为全球主要新闻头条，令观察家们感到意外，并在爱尔兰和英国引起反响。目前尚不清楚这些言论是否代表了新的政策或只是即兴的评论。

body.en:
When another world leader meets US President Donald Trump the only certainty about what might happen is the uncertainty about what might happen.

Nobody could have predicted that by the end of the first day, the main global headline would be his desire to see a unified Ireland .

As the shockwaves of his remarks rippled through this island and Great Britain, it was unclear whether this represented a new US administration policy, or an off-the-cuff remark from a president who likes to take questions from reporters, and likes to give answers.

Former Republican Congressman Mick Mulvaney was Trump's special envoy to Northern Ireland in his first term in office.

Although both agreed that Donald Trump was probably right to say that "eventually" unification would happen, that did not mean the US was about to start pushing for it.

Giving an answer to a question that is asked at a free-flowing press conference is one thing, but Donald Trump repeated his sentiments a short time later when he was delivering a speech to an invited audience at the US Ambassador's residence.

In fact it was almost the first thing he mentioned, hinting that maybe he realised he had kicked over a can of worms at his earlier appearance.

The rest of that speech was curious. It was billed as a 20-minute address to Irish and Irish American business leaders, but was about twice that and strayed largely into domestic US matters.

He can bounce from topic to topic during any speaking engagement, veering off the script and then returning to the matter at hand.

Today he lauded his own achievements, as he sees them, such as clamping down on illegal immigration, doing deals and boosting defence production.

He repeated his criticisms once again of what he views as the UK's lack of support for his military operation in Iran.

But who was his target audience? The gathered business leaders in Dublin or a US audience tuning in before it was even dawn in much of that country?

This November's crunch midterm elections are fast approaching and the Republican party is under intense pressure because of the president's policies.

About one tenth of the US population claim Irish heritage but they are not a homogeneous voting bloc.

Was he trying to target Irish-American independent or swing voters in the US, of which there are many who have flip-flopped between the Republican and Democratic party in recent years?

Some of them do support a unified Ireland and so in this time of chasing every vote, perhaps that played a part.

Bill Clinton secured a lot of Irish-American support when he was running for president, by promising to get engaged in the peace process.

They voted for him and he followed through on his promise and much of that work led to the foundations of the Good Friday Agreement.

But,...
body.zh: 当另一位世界领导人会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普时，可能发生的事情的唯一确定性就是可能发生的事情的不确定性。 没有人能预料到，到第一天结束时，全球主要头条新闻将是他希望看到一个统一的爱尔兰。 当他的言论引起轩然大波时，我们还不清楚这是否代表了美国政府的新政策，或者是一位喜欢接受记者提问、喜欢给出答案的总统的即兴言论。 前共和党众议员米克·马尔瓦尼是特朗普第一个任期内的北爱尔兰特使。 尽管两人都认为唐纳德·特朗普所说的“最终”统一可能是正确的，但这并不意味着美国即将开始推动统一。 在自由的新闻发布会上回答问题是一回事，但不久之后唐纳德·特朗普在美国大使官邸向受邀观众发表演讲时重申了他的观点。 事实上，这几乎是他提到的第一件事，暗示他可能意识到自己早些时候出现时踢翻了一罐蠕虫。 那次演讲的其余部分很有趣。据称，该演讲是针对爱尔兰人和爱尔兰裔美国商界领袖的 20 分钟演讲，但实际上是这个数字的两倍，而且主要涉及美国国内事务。 在任何演讲过程中，他都可以从一个话题跳到另一个话题，偏离剧本，然后回到手头的事情。 今天，他赞扬了自己所取得的成就，如他所看到的那样，例如打击非法移民、开展交易和提高国防生产。 他再次批评英国对其在伊朗的军事行动缺乏支持。 但他的目标受众是谁？聚集在都柏林的商界领袖，还是美国大部分地区黎明前收看节目的美国观众？ 今年11月关键的中期选举即将来临，共和党因总统的政策而承受着巨大的压力。 大约十分之一的美国人口声称拥有爱尔兰血统，但他们并不是一个同质的投票群体。 他是否试图针对美国的爱尔兰裔独立选民或摇摆选民，其中有许多人近年来在共和党和民主党之间摇摆不定？ 他们中的一些人确实支持统一的爱尔兰，因此在这个追逐每一张选票的时刻，也许这发挥了作用。 比尔·克林顿在竞选总统时承诺参与和平进程，从而获得了许多爱尔兰裔美国人的支持。 他们投票支持他，他兑现了自己的承诺，其中大部分工作为耶稣受难日协议奠定了基础。 但，...

reflection.en: The unpredictable nature of public statements, especially from prominent leaders, can have far-reaching consequences. James 3:5 reminds us that even a small spark, like a careless word, can ignite a large fire, influencing global discourse and local communities alike. It calls for careful consideration of our words and their potential impact.
reflection.zh: 公开言论的不可预测性，尤其是来自知名领导人的言论，可能产生深远的影响。雅各书3:5提醒我们，即使是微小的火花，如一句不经意的话，也能点燃熊熊大火，影响全球舆论和当地社区。这呼吁我们仔细斟酌言语及其潜在影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court
title.zh: 阿富汗女子因“外籍恐怖分子”法庭被驱逐出美国

summary.en: An Afghan woman, a legal resident of the US, was deported after choosing to leave rather than contest proceedings in the seldom-used Alien Terrorist Removal Court, a process her lawyers argued violated her due process rights.
summary.zh: 一名拥有美国合法居留权的阿富汗女子，在选择离开而非继续在鲜少使用的“外籍恐怖分子移除法庭”上辩护后被驱逐出境，她的律师认为这一程序侵犯了她的正当程序权利。

body.en:
An Afghan woman living in Texas with legal US permanent residency has been deported from the country in the first-ever use of a secretive court.

Nazira Haji Zada, 47, chose to leave the US rather than continue to argue her case before the Alien Terrorist Removal Court, according to the US Department of Justice (DOJ) and her lawyers.

The Alien Terrorist Removal Court was created in 1996, but had never heard a case before the proceedings in July. It is meant for non-US citizens facing terrorism-related charges when the evidence is confidential and related to national security.

Lawyers for Haji Zada argued that the case violated her right to due process under the US Constitution.

Afghanistan citizen Haji Zada was never charged with a crime, but prosecutors had tried and convicted her son and son-in-law for terror offenses.

Her son, Abdullah Haji Zada, and son-in-law, Nasir Ahmad Tawhed, were both found guilty of a plot to carry out a mass shooting on Election Day in 2024, inspired by the group calling itself Islamic State.

Haji Zada, who has been living in Fort Worth, Texas, was accused by prosecutors of being the "matriarch" of the group, who had worked "to radicalize the family".

In a statement on Friday, the justice department said she "conceded that she is an alien terrorist and waived appeal of the removal order, terminating her previous [immigration] status".

"This landmark case, resulting in the prompt removal of this alien terrorist to her country of origin, is a win for national security and the rule of law," said US Attorney General Todd Blanche.

"Those who support and condone terrorism should not be living in the United States, and this first-ever case before the ATRC shows how the Department will use every tool at its disposal to protect our country."

Court-appointed lawyers for Haji Zada said they were denied access to the evidence in her case.

"Our client's choice to consent to removal should not be seen as an endorsement of this court's legitimacy," public defenders Matthew Farley and Mary Manning Petras said in a statement to The Washington Post.

"Dragging lawful permanent residents into court but refusing to show them or their attorneys the evidence that will be used against them is a plain violation of due process. We are confident that the Alien Terrorist Removal Court will be struck down as unconstitutional as soon as a judge is asked to address the issue," they said.
body.zh: 一名居住在德克萨斯州、拥有美国合法永久居留权的阿富汗妇女被驱逐出境，这是有史以来第一次使用秘密法庭。 据美国司法部 (DOJ) 及其律师称，47 岁的纳齐拉·哈吉·扎达 (Nazira Haji Zada) 选择离开美国，而不是继续在外国恐怖分子遣返法庭上辩论自己的案件。 外国人恐怖分子遣返法庭成立于1996年，但在7月开庭审理之前从未审理过任何案件。它适用于面临与恐怖主义相关指控的非美国公民，且证据属于机密且与国家安全相关。 哈吉扎达的律师辩称，该案侵犯了她根据美国宪法享有的正当程序权利。 阿富汗公民哈吉·扎达从未被指控犯罪，但检察官已对她的儿子和女婿进行了审判并判其犯有恐怖罪。 她的儿子阿卜杜拉·哈吉·扎达 (Abdullah Haji Zada) 和女婿纳西尔·艾哈迈德·陶希德 (Nasir Ahmad Tawhed) 均被判犯有在 2024 年选举日实施大规模枪击事件的阴谋，其灵感来自于自称“伊斯兰国”的组织。 一直居住在德克萨斯州沃思堡的哈吉扎达被检察官指控为该组织的“女族长”，并致力于“使家庭变得激进”。 司法部在周五的一份声明中表示，她“承认自己是一名外籍恐怖分子，并放弃了对驱逐令的上诉，终止了她之前的[移民]身份”。 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇表示：“这一具有里程碑意义的案件导致这名外籍恐怖分子迅速被遣送回原籍国，这是国家安全和法治的胜利。” “那些支持和纵容恐怖主义的人不应该生活在美国，ATRC 收到的第一起案件表明，该部门将如何利用其掌握的一切工具来保护我们的国家。” 法庭为哈吉·扎达指定的律师表示，他们被拒绝获取该案的证据。 公设辩护人马修·法利和玛丽·曼宁·佩特拉斯在给《华盛顿邮报》的一份声明中表示：“我们的委托人选择同意转移，不应被视为对本法院合法性的认可。” 他们说：“将合法永久居民拖上法庭，但拒绝向他们或他们的律师出示用于指控他们的证据，这明显违反了正当程序。我们相信，一旦法官被要求解决这个问题，外国恐怖分子驱逐法庭就会因违宪而被推翻。”

reflection.en: Nazira Haji Zada's case, where a legal resident was deported without criminal charges due to family ties, raises profound questions about justice and belonging. The scripture reminds us to welcome the foreigner, for we too were once strangers. May we extend compassion and uphold due process for all, especially those without a voice in a powerful land.
reflection.zh: 纳齐拉·哈吉·扎达的案件，一位合法居民因家庭联系而被驱逐，却未被起诉任何罪名，这引发了关于公正和归属感的深刻问题。经文提醒我们当爱护客旅，因为我们自己也曾是寄居的。愿我们都能向所有人施以怜悯，并维护正当程序，尤其是在这片强大的土地上为那些无声者发声。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Kostaq's family lives by a stunning European wilderness area. Trump's family wants to build a resort there
title.zh: 科斯塔克的家人生活在一个令人惊叹的欧洲荒野地区。特朗普的家人想在那里建造一个度假村

summary.en: Plans for a luxury resort promoted by Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump have sparked outrage and a land ownership dispute in Zvërnec, Albania, where an 81-year-old olive grower, Kostaq Konomi, has deep ancestral ties to the land.
summary.zh: 由贾里德·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普推广的豪华度假村计划在阿尔巴尼亚的兹韦尔内茨引发了愤怒和土地所有权纠纷，81岁的橄榄种植者科斯塔克·科诺米对这片土地有着深厚的祖传联系。

body.en:
Watch Dateline's latest episode, Albania’s Luxury Tourism Turmoil, on 15 September at 9.30pm AEST on SBS or SBS On Demand. 

For 81-year-old olive grower Kostaq Konomi, the soil of his land in Zvërnec, a coastal village in central Albania, is full of memories.

"He would plant things, whereas I, as the beach was close there, I would go and pick the seashells.

"I used to have a herd of goats and together with other friends from our village, would go there [and] graze them."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The fertile land he describes sits on the Vjosa-Narta lagoon, a once-protected wetland home to more than 200 resident and migratory bird species, including flamingos.

The lagoon’s salt flats attract flocks of flamingos across different seasons, with September bringing a pink spectacle as thousands arrive as part of their migration between Europe and Africa.

Described as one of Europe’s last great wilderness frontiers, this fragile ecosystem also includes the rare Dalmatian pelican, loggerhead sea turtles that nest in the dunes and the endangered Mediterranean monk seal.

Kostaq is proud of the beauty that can be found around his village — his family has lived here for generations and has owned the same house since 1880. The family remained during communist rule, when the land was collectivised and owned by the state. Their ownership returned when the regime fell in the 1990s.

But earlier this year, Kostaq became aware of a new threat to his land. He is part of a group of residents who say their land has been sold off without their knowledge for a luxury resort development, linked to the family of US President Donald Trump .

In 2024, Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner unveiled plans on social media for his investment firm to develop a luxury resort across two locations in Albania: the Zvërnec peninsula and a small island off its coast, Sazan, which used to serve as a communist-era military outpost.

That same year, the Albanian parliament passed a law rolling back environmental safeguards permitting high-end tourism-related construction inside previously protected zones, like the Vjosa-Narta Lagoon.

Kushner is reportedly planning to invest an estimated US$6.1 billion ($8.4 billion) in the proposed development.

Promoting the project on a podcast in May, Kushner's wife Ivanka, who is Trump’s eldest daughter, explained the couple had "discovered" Sazan Island and the nearby Zvërnec peninsula while cruising the Adriatic on a friend's super-yacht in 2021.

The resort is set to feature around 10,000 hotel rooms and luxury villas, high-end restaurants, a waterpark, casino...
body.zh: 于 9 月 15 日晚 9 点 30 分（澳大利亚东部标准时间）在 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 观看《Dateline》的最新一集《阿尔巴尼亚的豪华旅游动荡》。 对于 81 岁的橄榄种植者 Kostaq Konomi 来说，他位于阿尔巴尼亚中部沿海村庄 Zvërnec 土地上的土壤充满了回忆。 “他会种东西，而我，因为海滩离那里很近，所以我会去捡贝壳。 “我曾经有一群山羊，和村里的其他朋友一起去那里放牧它们。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他描述的这片肥沃的土地坐落在维约萨-纳尔塔泻湖上，这片曾经受保护的湿地是 200 多种留鸟和候鸟的家园，其中包括火烈鸟。 泻湖的盐滩在不同季节吸引着成群的火烈鸟，九月带来了粉红色的奇观，数千只火烈鸟在欧洲和非洲之间迁徙。 这个脆弱的生态系统被描述为欧洲最后的荒野边境之一，还包括稀有的达尔马提亚鹈鹕、在沙丘中筑巢的红海龟以及濒临灭绝的地中海僧海豹。 Kostaq 为他的村庄周围的美景感到自豪——他的家人世世代代住在这里，自 1880 年起就拥有同一栋房子。在共产主义统治期间，这个家庭仍然存在，当时土地被集体化并归国家所有。当 20 世纪 90 年代政权垮台时，他们的所有权又回来了。 但今年早些时候，科斯塔克意识到他的土地面临新的威胁。他是一群居民中的一员，他们表示，他们的土地在他们不知情的情况下被出售，用于开发与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普家族有关的豪华度假村。 2024 年，特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳 (Jared Kushner) 在社交媒体上公布了他的投资公司在阿尔巴尼亚两个地点开发豪华度假村的计划：兹韦尔内克半岛和其海岸附近的小岛萨赞 (Sazan)，萨赞曾是共产主义时代的军事前哨。 同年，阿尔巴尼亚议会通过了一项法律，取消环境保护措施，允许在维约萨-纳尔塔泻湖等以前的保护区内进行与旅游相关的高端建设。 据报道，库什纳计划在拟议的开发项目中投资估计 61 亿美元（84 亿美元）。 库什纳的妻子、特朗普的大女儿伊万卡今年 5 月在播客上宣传该项目，她解释说，这对夫妇在 2021 年乘坐朋友的超级游艇在亚得里亚海巡航时“发现”了萨赞岛和附近的兹维尔内克半岛。 该度假村设有约 10,000 间酒店客房和豪华别墅、高档餐厅、水上乐园、赌场......

For Kostaq Konomi, his land is a repository of memory and livelihood, deeply connected to his past. The proposed resort raises questions about who benefits from such projects and whether the rights and traditions of long-term residents are being justly...
reflection.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚维约萨-纳尔塔泻湖的新闻，触及了发展与当地传统之间的紧张关系。对科斯塔克·科诺米来说，他的土地是记忆和生计的载体，与他的过去紧密相连。拟议中的度假村引发了关于谁能从这些项目中受益，以及长期居民的权利和传统是否得到公正考虑的问题。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Trump visits Ireland, says unification would be 'fantastic'
title.zh: 特朗普访问爱尔兰，称统一将是“极好的”

summary.en: US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there. During his visit, Trump expressed his desire to see the Republic of Ireland unite with British-run Northern Ireland.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普前往爱尔兰观看高尔夫比赛的行程中，还包括与当地领导人的会晤。在访问期间，特朗普表达了他希望看到爱尔兰共和国与英国统治下的北爱尔兰统一的愿望。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump's trip to Ireland to watch a golf tournament has also included meetings with leaders there.

US President Donald Trump has said he would "love" to see the Republic of Ireland , an EU member, unite with British-run ⁠Northern Ireland as he faced reporters' questions on a range of issues on Saturday.

Trump is taking the weekend trip largely to watch the Irish Open golf tournament held on a course he owns on the country’s Atlantic coast, but he met as well with the Irish president and prime minister, or taoiseach.

The US leader also spoke optimistically about his country's war with Iran and its trade conflict with Canada , among several other topics.

After a meeting with Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin in the capital, Dublin, Trump said he very much supported what he said would be the eventual unification of the two parts of the island of Ireland.

"Well, I don't want to ​cause any problems, ​but ‌I will tell you, I'd love to see ‌it unified," Trump told ‌reporters.

"The way I look at it, it's ⁠going ​to happen ​eventually ... I think it would ​be a ‌fantastic thing," he added.

"Now the UK will have ​something ⁠to say about it ... but ⁠I think ​it would be a great thing."

The British government responded swiftly to the remarks, with Prime Minister Andy Burham's office saying that in his view, there was no majority public support for a referendum on the issue and that there would not be another one until that changed. 

Previous US presidents have avoided touching on the subject in view of the delicate nature of the issue, with Northern Ireland seeing decades of of deadly sectarian violence in the 20th century over the question of whom it should belong to.

Trump also said that the US war with Iran, which began on February 28, would "end very soon" — a view he has frequently expressed in the past, but which has not yet materialized.

He also said that the end of the conflict would mean that the price of oil, which has soared as a result of the war, would "come tumbling down."

However, he vehemently defended his decision to mount the military operation against Iran.

He said that the US attacked because "Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon", adding: "They were two weeks away from having a nuclear weapon."

"If they had it, they would have blown up Israel, they would have blown up the Middle East, and they would have hit some [...] in my opinion, [of] Europe's cities and beyond cities, and they would probably hit us soon before we put out the fire. But they cannot have a nuclear weapon."

The war with Iran is not supported by a majority of the US population, particularly in view of promises made by Trump on the campaign trail to keep his country out of foreign...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普前往爱尔兰观看高尔夫锦标赛的行程还包括与当地领导人的会面。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在周六就一系列问题接受记者提问时表示，他“乐意”看到欧盟成员国爱尔兰共和国与英国管理的北爱尔兰团结起来。 特朗普周末旅行主要是为了观看在该国大西洋海岸他拥有的球场上举行的爱尔兰高尔夫公开赛，但他也会见了爱尔兰总统和总理（或称爱尔兰总理）。 这位美国领导人还乐观地谈到了美国与伊朗的战争以及与加拿大的贸易冲突等几个话题。 在首都都柏林与爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁会面后，特朗普表示，他非常支持他所说的爱尔兰岛两部分的最终统一。 “好吧，我不想造成任何问题，但我会告诉你，我很乐意看到它统一，”特朗普告诉记者。 “在我看来，这最终会发生……我认为这将是一件奇妙的事情，”他补充道。 “现在英国对此有话要说……但我认为这将是一件伟大的事情。” 英国政府迅速回应了这一言论，首相安迪·伯勒姆的办公室表示，在他看来，没有大多数公众支持就此问题举行公投，并且在情况改变之前不会再举行公投。 鉴于该问题的微妙性质，历任美国总统都避免触及这一主题，北爱尔兰在 20 世纪因归属问题而发生了数十年致命的宗派暴力。 特朗普还表示，2月28日开始的美国与伊朗的战争将“很快结束”——这是他过去经常表达的观点，但尚未实现。 他还表示，冲突的结束将意味着因战争而飙升的石油价格将“暴跌”。 然而，他强烈捍卫自己对伊朗采取军事行动的决定。 他说，美国发动袭击是因为“伊朗无法拥有核武器”，并补充道：“他们距离拥有核武器还有两周的时间。” “如果他们拥有的话，他们会炸毁以色列，他们会炸毁中东，他们会袭击一些……在我看来，欧洲的城市和其他城市，他们可能会在我们扑灭大火之前不久袭击我们。但他们不可能拥有核武器。” 与伊朗的战争并没有得到大多数美国民众的支持，特别是考虑到特朗普在竞选过程中做出的让他的国家远离外国的承诺……

reflection.en: During his visit to Ireland, President Trump voiced his support for the unification of the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland. This statement, made amidst a golf tournament, touches upon the long-standing political aspirations and complexities of the region. The pursuit of peace and reconciliation often involves navigating deeply rooted historical and...
reflection.zh: 在访问爱尔兰期间，特朗普总统表达了他对爱尔兰共和国与北爱尔兰统一的支持。这一声明是在高尔夫比赛期间发表的，触及了该地区长期存在的政治愿望和复杂性。追求和平与和解往往需要驾驭根深蒂固的历史和政治格局，这是一个需要所有相关方耐心和理解的过程。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The US's "extremely frank" conversations with Putin and Zelensky
title.zh: 美俄乌领导人会晤的“极其坦诚”对话

summary.en: The US, as the host country for the G20, is actively working to arrange a meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to de-escalate the conflict.
summary.zh: 作为G20的东道主，美国正积极促成俄罗斯总统普京与乌克兰总统泽连斯基的会晤，以缓和冲突。

body.en:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he would be willing to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a G20 summit in December, in an interview released Saturday, as efforts intensify to end the conflict.

The US is seeking to kick-start long-stalled negotiations to find a solution to the conflict, Europe's deadliest since World War II, with US negotiators recently visiting Kyiv and Moscow and President Donald Trump and Putin this week holding talks on the conflict over the phone.

The US holds this year's presidency of the Group of 20 major economies, which comprises 19 countries plus the European Union and the African Union, and culminates in a leaders' summit in Miami in December.

Russia's finance minister has already attended one G20 meeting, causing discomfort among some of Ukraine's allies, and a Russian diplomat said Saturday that Moscow will also send some officials to a G20 energy meeting in Houston next week.

Asked whether he would be willing to meet Putin at the December summit if both leaders were invited, Zelensky told German broadcaster Deutsche Welle: "Yes, of course.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It's not about words. What I will tell him or what he wants to tell me, it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter. Matters only result. Result matters. That's it."

Last weekend, US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner visited Moscow and Putin and Trump also discussed the war earlier in the week in what the Kremlin termed an "extremely frank" and constructive hour-long phone call.

In the Deutsche Welle interview, which took place Friday in Canada, Zelensky said that Witkoff and Kushner's visit was a "good signal", and it was important the pair had visited Kyiv as well as Moscow.

Zelensky has also announced he plans to meet Trump in late September, as the US pushes for fresh face-to-face talks between Moscow and Kyiv.

Asked about Ukraine's position ahead of possible negotiations, Zelensky responded: "Ukraine now is much more stronger than last year on the battlefield."

Russia was sustaining heavy battlefield losses, paying a "big price" for "very slow moves on the battlefield," he said.

Ukraine has said the talks could happen as early as this month, but Russia on Monday said it was "too early" to discuss a venue or dates.

Several previous rounds of negotiations have failed. Trust between the sides is low, and there is no sign that Russia or Ukraine have shifted their positions.

Both countries have escalated long-range strikes on each other in recent months, leading to the highest civilian death toll since the early days of the war.

Zelensky also repeated his call for Ukraine's allies to provide more interceptor...
body.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基在周六发布的采访中表示，随着结束冲突的努力加紧，他愿意在 12 月的 G20 峰会上会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。 美国正在寻求启动长期停滞的谈判，以找到解决这场二战以来欧洲最严重的冲突的方案，美国谈判代表最近访问了基辅和莫斯科，唐纳德·特朗普总统和普京本周就冲突进行了电话会谈。 美国担任今年二十国集团主要经济体主席国，该集团由 19 个国家以及欧盟和非洲联盟组成，最终将于 12 月在迈阿密举行领导人峰会。 俄罗斯财政部长已经出席了一次G20会议，引起乌克兰一些盟友的不安，一名俄罗斯外交官周六表示，莫斯科还将派一些官员参加下周在休斯敦举行的G20能源会议。 当被问及如果两位领导人都受到邀请，他是否愿意在 12 月峰会上与普京会面时，泽伦斯基告诉德国广播公司德国之声：“是的，当然。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这不是言语的问题。我会告诉他什么或者他想告诉我什么，并不重要。没关系。事情只有结果。结果很重要。就是这样。” 上周末，美国谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳访问了莫斯科，普京和特朗普也在本周早些时候讨论了这场战争，克里姆林宫称这是一次“极其坦诚”和建设性的长达一小时的电话。 泽连斯基周五在加拿大接受德国之声采访时表示，威特科夫和库什纳的访问是一个“好信号”，两人访问基辅和莫斯科很重要。 泽伦斯基还宣布，他计划在 9 月下旬会见特朗普，因为美国正在推动莫斯科和基辅之间进行新的面对面会谈。 当被问及乌克兰在可能的谈判之前的立场时，泽伦斯基回答说：“乌克兰现在在战场上比去年强大得多。” 他说，俄罗斯在战场上损失惨重，为“战场行动非常缓慢”付出了“巨大代价”。 乌克兰表示，会谈最早可能在本月举行，但俄罗斯周一表示，讨论地点或日期“还为时过早”。 此前的几轮谈判均以失败告终。双方之间的信任度很低，而且没有迹象表明俄罗斯或乌克兰已经改变立场。 近几个月来，两国都升级了对对方的远程打击，导致平民死亡人数达到战争初期以来的最高水平。 泽连斯基还再次呼吁乌克兰盟友提供更多拦截弹……

reflection.en: In the midst of Europe's deadliest conflict since World War II, the US is engaging in "extremely frank" conversations, seeking to bring Presidents Putin and Zelensky together at the G20 summit. This diplomatic effort embodies the Beatitude, "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God."
reflection.zh: 在欧洲自二战以来最致命的冲突中，美国正进行“极其坦诚”的对话，试图在G20峰会上促成普京总统与泽连斯基总统的会晤。这一外交努力体现了“使人和睦的人有福了，因为人要称他们为神的儿子”的八福。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Corals as climate archive: Are El Ninos intensifying?
title.zh: 珊瑚作为气候档案：厄尔尼诺现象是否正在加剧？

summary.en: Records from recent decades indicate that El Nino events have been frequent and often extreme. This story explores whether this pattern is normal or a consequence of climate change, using coral records as a key indicator.
summary.zh: 近几十年的记录表明，厄尔尼诺现象频繁且常常极端。这个故事探讨这种模式是正常的还是气候变化的后果，并以珊瑚记录作为关键指标。

body.en:
Records from the past few decades show that, during this period, El Nino events have been frequent and often extreme. But is this normal, or is it the result of climate change? Corals can give us a clear indication.

A storm is gathering. Most likely a very big one. El Nino is a natural climate phenomenon occurring every two to seven years, towards the end of the year, but it comes in various different strengths, depending on the prevailing conditions.

El Ninos are considered strong if the surface temperature of the water off the west coast of South America is more than 1.5 degrees Celsius above average. In July this year, the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) was already observing temperature increases of greater than three degrees Celsius in the eastern and central Pacific.

The German Meteorological Service believes this "could in all likelihood develop into one of the strongest El Nino events since records began."

But a recent article by the Max Planck Institute for Meteorology states that whether or not strong El Nino events will intensify as a result of climate change "remains the subject of ongoing research."

The problem is that the data on ocean surface temperatures is only truly reliable from the 1980s onward, with the start of satellite observation. And this data doesn't tell us how El Nino behaved before industrialization and the burning of fossil fuels.

US researchers say corals can help to close this knowledge gap. Julia Cole, a climate scientist and paleoclimatologist at the University of Michigan, and her team recently  published a study  on this subject in the journal Science .

"We've known for a long time that the last 40 or 50 years has really strong El Nino events," says Cole. "It's been hard to say whether the recent strong El Nino that we've had is part of a natural cycle, or if it's something a little bit unusual related to being in a warmer than normal world." The coral analysis points firmly in one direction: Unusual. Not normal.

Cole and her team examined fossilized and living corals around the Galapagos Islands off Ecuador in the eastern Pacific. Corals grow between one and two centimeters per year, and in doing so form a structure similar to growth rings on trees. "We made use of the fact that corals record ocean temperatures as they grow, in the chemical composition of their skeleton," Cole explains.

Corals are living creatures that construct external skeletons through calcification, adding a band of new growth each year with calcium carbonate precipitated from the surrounding water. In this way, over decades and centuries, corals have formed entire reef systems. Other chemical elements are also incorporated into the skeleton during the calcification process — strontium, for...
body.zh: 过去几十年的记录表明，这一时期厄尔尼诺现象频繁且极端。但这是正常现象还是气候变化的结果？珊瑚可以给我们一个明确的指示。 一场风暴正在聚集。很可能是一个非常大的。厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候现象，每两到七年在年底发生一次，但根据当时的情况，它有各种不同的强度。 如果南美洲西海岸附近的海水表面温度比平均水平高出 1.5 摄氏度以上，则厄尔尼诺现象被视为强厄尔尼诺现象。今年7月，美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）已经观察到东太平洋和中太平洋气温上升超过3摄氏度。 德国气象局认为，这“很可能发展成为有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件之一”。 但马克斯·普朗克气象研究所最近发​​表的一篇文章指出，强烈的厄尔尼诺事件是否会因气候变化而加剧“仍然是正在进行的研究的主题”。 问题在于，海洋表面温度的数据只有在 20 世纪 80 年代卫星观测开始后才真正可靠。这些数据并没有告诉我们厄尔尼诺现象在工业化和化石燃料燃烧之前的表现如何。 美国研究人员表示，珊瑚可以帮助缩小这一知识差距。密歇根大学的气候科学家和古气候学家朱莉娅·科尔 (Julia Cole) 和她的团队最近在《科学》杂志上发表了一项关于这一主题的研究。 “我们很早就知道，过去 40 或 50 年发生了非常强烈的厄尔尼诺事件，”科尔说。 “很难说最近发生的强烈厄尔尼诺现象是否是自然循环的一部分，或者是否与世界比正常温暖有关，有些不寻常。”珊瑚分析坚定地指向一个方向：不寻常。不正常。 科尔和她的团队检查了东太平洋厄瓜多尔附近的加拉帕戈斯群岛周围的化石和活珊瑚。珊瑚每年生长一到两厘米，并在此过程中形成类似于树木年轮的结构。 “我们利用了珊瑚在生长过程中通过其骨骼的化学成分记录海洋温度的事实，”科尔解释道。 珊瑚是通过钙化构建外部骨骼的生物，每年都会利用周围水中沉淀的碳酸钙增加新的生长带。就这样，经过几十年和几个世纪，珊瑚形成了完整的珊瑚礁系统。在钙化过程中，其他化学元素也会融入骨骼中——锶，用于......

reflection.en: The intricate coral records reveal a planet under stress, with El Nino events intensifying. As we observe these changes, we are reminded that the Earth and all its inhabitants are the creation of Yahweh. This understanding calls us to be faithful stewards of the world entrusted to us, caring for its delicate ecosystems.
reflection.zh: 复杂的珊瑚记录揭示了一个承受压力的星球，厄尔尼诺现象日益加剧。当我们观察到这些变化时，我们被提醒，地和其中万物都属于雅伟。这一认识呼吁我们成为受托管理的世界的忠实管家，关爱其脆弱的生态系统。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Uber leaves two key African markets — and their drivers in despair
title.zh: 优步退出非洲两大市场——将其司机留在了绝望之中

summary.en: Uber's withdrawal from Nigeria and Uganda has left many drivers in a difficult situation. With increasing costs for fuel and maintenance, drivers are finding it hard to earn a living, especially after the company's unexpected exit from these markets.
summary.zh: 优步退出尼日利亚和乌干达市场，使得许多司机陷入困境。随着燃油和维修成本的不断上涨，司机们在公司意外退出这些市场后，发现维持生计变得异常艰难。

body.en:
Uber's departure from Nigeria and Uganda has left countless customers high and dry. But what about drivers? With fuel prices, maintenance, and other operating costs rising, many say they're struggling to make a living.

A week ago, Uber unexpectedly announced its departure from the Nigerian market after spending more than a decade building up its presence in Africa's most populous country. The ride-hailing platform also said it would be winding up its operations in Uganda — also with immediate effect.

With the exit from both Nigeria and Uganda , Uber now remains operational only in a handful of African countries — Egypt, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa.

"This decision is limited strictly to these two markets and does not impact our operations across the rest of the continent," Uber said in a statement, adding that their "immediate priority is supporting drivers, riders, and local team members throughout this transition," without sharing details on what this assistance would entail.

In the last year, the multinational company also closed shop in Ivory Coast and Tanzania, while also cutting its global workforce by 10%.

Uber has not managed to grow across much of the African market despite its massive global scale. The profit-driven ride-hailing app faces stiff competition from rival platforms, including Bolt, inDrive and SafeBoda, which operate in the Nigerian and Ugandan markets and beyond.

However, it's not only Uber that is having to deal with its frustration over the current situation: Many of its drivers across Africa have been raising complaints about shrinking profit margins amid rising fuel costs, inflation and currency volatility, especially in markets like Nigeria.

In their view, Uber's business model of pocketing around 20% — 25% of any trip fare in commissions is no longer tenable.

Abbas Olamide, an Uber driver in the Nigerian capital Abuja, said the company's overall service was "good," while firmly stressing that the high commission rates were adding greatly to his existing woes .

He told DW that a ride of 30,000 Naira (€20) "to the airport means the ride-hailing app would deduct 6,000 Naira as commission," still leaving him to "then pay a gate fee at the airport."

"Probably because you do not want to go back to town empty-handed, we also pay to park at the airport [to pick up another client]," he explained.

Samuel Olatunji, an Uber-driver in the megacity Lagos, also shared his concerns with DW following the abrupt announcement of Uber's exit, saying he will now have to recalibrate his own business model.

The 43-year-old driver says he'll have to join hundreds of other drivers who "have to depend on other [ride-hailing] apps now" to ensure any steady stream of income.

In recent years, drivers like Olamide...
body.zh: Uber退出尼日利亚和乌干达让无数客户陷入困境。但司机呢？随着燃料价格、维护和其他运营成本的上涨，许多人表示他们正在为生计而苦苦挣扎。 一周前，优步出人意料地宣布退出尼日利亚市场，此前该公司花了十多年时间在非洲人口最多的国家建立了业务。该叫车平台还表示将结束在乌干达的业务，并立即生效。 随着尼日利亚和乌干达的退出，优步现在只在少数非洲国家继续运营——埃及、加纳、肯尼亚和南非。 优步在一份声明中表示：“这一决定严格限于这两个市场，不会影响我们在非洲大陆其他地区的运营。”并补充说，他们的“当务之急是在整个过渡过程中为司机、乘客和当地团队成员提供支持”，但没有透露这项援助所需的详细信息。 去年，这家跨国公司还关闭了在科特迪瓦和坦桑尼亚的工厂，同时还削减了 10% 的全球员工。 尽管优步在全球规模庞大，但未能在非洲大部分市场实现增长。这款以利润为导向的叫车应用程序面临着来自竞争对手平台的激烈竞争，包括在尼日利亚和乌干达等市场运营的 Bolt、inDrive 和 SafeBoda。 然而，不仅仅是优步必须应对当前形势的沮丧：非洲各地的许多司机都在抱怨燃油成本上涨、通货膨胀和货币波动导致利润率下降，尤其是在尼日利亚等市场。 在他们看来，Uber 将出行费用的 20% 至 25% 左右作为佣金的商业模式已经站不住脚了。 尼日利亚首都阿布贾的优步司机阿巴斯·奥拉米德表示，该公司的整体服务“良好”，同时坚定地强调，高额佣金大大加剧了他现有的困境。 他告诉德国之声，前往机场的乘车费用为 30,000 奈拉（20 欧元），“意味着叫车应用程序将扣除 6,000 奈拉作为佣金”，但他仍然“需要在机场支付登机费”。 “可能是因为你不想空手回城，我们还支付在机场停车的费用（以接另一位客户），”他解释道。 在Uber突然宣布退出后，特大城市拉各斯的Uber司机塞缪尔·奥拉通吉(Samuel Olatunji)也向德国之声表达了他的担忧，称他现在必须重新调整自己的商业模式。 这位 43 岁的司机表示，他将不得不加入数百名其他司机的行列，“现在必须依赖其他[叫车]应用程序”来确保稳定的收入来源。 近年来，像奥拉米德这样的车手...

reflection.en: The departure of Uber from Nigeria and Uganda leaves many drivers in a precarious economic situation. James's words in chapter 5 speak powerfully to the plight of workers whose wages are withheld or whose livelihoods are disrupted by corporate decisions. This situation calls for empathy and a consideration of the human cost behind business strategies.
reflection.zh: 优步退出尼日利亚和乌干达，使许多司机陷入了经济困境。雅各书第五章的话语有力地道出了工人们的困境，他们的工资被拖欠，或者他们的生计因公司的决定而中断。这种情况呼唤着同情心，并需要我们考虑商业策略背后的人力成本。

verse.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of Yahweh Almighty.
verse.textZh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。

title.en: Australians love traveling to the UK. They could soon be paying more
title.zh: 英国人喜爱前往英国旅行。他们可能很快就要支付更多费用了

summary.en: The UK government is moving ahead with a controversial levy, the 'Overnight Visitor Levy,' which will allow regional mayors to charge a percentage on accommodation stays. Prime Minister Andy Burnham hopes this tax will help shift power and money away from London, with the 1.2 million Australians who visit the UK...
summary.zh: 英国政府正着手实施一项有争议的收费项目——“过夜游客税”，该项目将允许地区市长按比例收取住宿费用。安迪·伯纳姆首相希望这项税收能帮助将权力和资金从伦敦转移出去，每年访问英国的120万澳大利亚游客可能会面临更高的费用。

body.en:
The bill is about to get steeper for the 1.2 million Australians who travel to the UK every year as British mayors will soon have the power to charge a so-called "tourist tax" on accommodation.

Last week the UK government announced it was going to be pressing ahead with the controversial levy which Prime Minister Andy Burnham — the so called "King of the North" — hopes will help move power and money way from London.

Called the "Overnight Visitor Levy," it gives regional mayors the option to tax people on a percentage of their stays at hotels, bed and breakfasts and other types of accommodation.

Burnham— who replaced Keir Starmer as prime minister in July— sees the levy as a way of financially empowering regional cities.

He said last week the tax would come into force towards the end of the next financial year, with mayors expected to set out spending plans for the funds raised by early 2028.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The levy will be set at the discretion of city councils but on Friday Labour mayors in 10 regional cities said they would cap the charge the charge at five per cent, following widespread concerns from the hospitality industry that the levy would dampen spending.

An exact date for the levy's introduction has not been announced but Burnham said the tax would come into force towards the end of next financial year and apply to both Britons and international tourists.

The exact terms of the levy could vary from city to city, but mayors in London, Greater Manchester, Liverpool City Region, West Midlands, North East, West of England, West Yorkshire, South Yorkshire, East Midlands and York and North Yorkshire have all agreed to the five per cent cap.

Two Reform UK mayors and two Conservative party mayors have said they would oppose any levy — so its possible the price of accommodation will go up in some cities, but not others.

While the five per cent levy would be new for regional cities in Britain, it's not a UK first.

In July, Edinburgh launched a 5 per cent levy on accommodation that's capped at five nights and similar taxes are already common around the world.

New York, LA, Brussels, Amsterdam, Toronto and Montreal all have their own equivalent charges.

Wales is set to introduce it's own £1.30 per person per night levy in April of next year.

The move has not been supported by UKHospitality, which represents the sector. It said the move would hurt British families and add to red tape.

"Give mayors one tax-raising power on one sector and they will pull that lever until it snaps," said Chief Executive Allen Simpson.

Simpson cited research by consultancy Oxford Economics estimating...
body.zh: 由于英国市长很快将有权对住宿征收所谓的“旅游税”，因此每年前往英国旅游的 120 万澳大利亚人的账单将变得更加昂贵。 上周，英国政府宣布将推进有争议的征税，被称为“北方之王”的首相安迪·伯纳姆希望此举有助于将权力和金钱从伦敦转移出去。 它被称为“过夜游客税”，它让地区市长可以选择对人们在酒店、住宿加早餐和其他类型住宿的住宿比例征税。 伯纳姆于 7 月接替凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 出任总理，他认为征税是增强地区城市财政实力的一种方式。 他上周表示，该税收将在下一个财政年度结束时生效，预计市长们将制定 2028 年初筹集资金的支出计划。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 征税将由市议会自行决定，但周五，10 个地区城市的工党市长表示，由于酒店业普遍担心征税会抑制支出，他们将把收费上限限制在 5%。 征收该税的具体日期尚未公布，但伯纳姆表示，该税将于下财年末生效，适用于英国人和国际游客。 征税的具体条款可能因城市而异，但伦敦、大曼彻斯特、利物浦城市地区、西米德兰兹、东北部、英格兰西部、西约克郡、南约克郡、东米德兰兹以及约克和北约克郡的市长都同意5%的上限。 两位英国改革派市长和两位保守党市长表示，他们反对任何征税——因此，一些城市的住宿价格可能会上涨，但其他城市则不会。 虽然百分之五的征税对于英国地区城市来说是新举措，但这并不是英国首创。 7月，爱丁堡对住宿征收5%的税，上限为五晚，类似的税收在世界各地已经很常见。 纽约、洛杉矶、布鲁塞尔、阿姆斯特丹、多伦多和蒙特利尔都有各自的同等费用。 威尔士将于明年 4 月推出每人每晚 1.30 英镑的税收。 此举并未得到代表该行业的英国酒店业协会的支持。它表示此举将伤害英国家庭并增加繁文缛节。 首席执行官艾伦·辛普森 (Allen Simpson) 表示：“赋予市长对某个行业增税的权力，他们就会拉动杠杆，直到杠杆断裂为止。” 辛普森引用了牛津经济咨询公司的研究估计……

reflection.en: The proposal for an 'Overnight Visitor Levy' in the UK highlights how local leaders seek to fund public services and regional development. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds us that rulers are called to 'execute justice and righteousness' and 'deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This principle calls leaders to consider the impact of their...
reflection.zh: 英国提议征收“过夜游客税”，这凸显了地方领导人如何寻求为公共服务和区域发展提供资金。《耶利米书》22章3节提醒我们，统治者被呼召要“施行公平和公义”，并“从欺压者的手中拯救那受欺压的”。这一原则呼吁领导人考虑其财政决策对所有人的影响，确保政策服务于共同利益，并且不会给游客或居民带来不当负担。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Russia's drone war comes to Moldova and Romania
title.zh: 俄罗斯的无人机战争蔓延至摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚

summary.en: Russian drone incursions into the airspace of Moldova and Romania are becoming more frequent. This week, the Ukrainian president's plane was prevented from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect these incursions are intentional.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯无人机侵入摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚领空的事件日益频繁。本周，乌克兰总统的飞机在基希讷乌被阻止起飞。观察家们怀疑这些入侵是故意的。

body.en:
Incursions by Russian drones into Moldovan and Romanian airspace are increasingly common. This week the Ukrainian president's plane was stopped from taking off from Chisinau. Observers suspect the attacks are deliberate.

For Ukrainians, Russia's air war has been a bitter, bloody reality for years. People in Ukraine are being  killed every day by missiles, bombs, and drones . But the country's central and southeastern European neighbors have also found themselves affected, albeit on a smaller scale: Missiles and drones sometimes invade their air space, and occasionally even crash on their territory.

Now the Russian drone war is coming dangerously close to two of Ukraine's neighbors: Romania and the Republic of Moldova , where drone incidents are now an almost daily occurrence. The drones often explode, leaving people injured, and there have also been recent attacks on Ukrainian checkpoints at the Moldovan and Romanian borders.

The attacks have now escalated to such a degree that many observers believe they can no longer be considered unintentional. They suspect the Kremlin is deliberately trying to bring the war to Ukraine's neighbors.

The latest drone incursion and crash on Tuesday caused a furore as it prevented a plane with the Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on board from taking off in the Moldovan capital Chisinau. A Russian Geran drone, which can fly as fast as 500 kilometers per hour (311 mph), took off in Crimea, then flew through Ukrainian airspace and eventually crashed in a sunflower field near the Moldovan city of Riscani.

The drone also flew over Romania, where two fighter jets were scrambled from NATO's Kogalniceanu airbase near the Black Sea port of Constanta, though it remains unclear why they did not shoot down the drone, as they had on other occasions.

The most serious aspect of the incident was that it showed how limited Moldovan air defense is in its ability to protect the country's air space. The drones were detected and tracked by air traffic control, but it was not possible to shoot them down. According to publicly available information, the country possesses only a small number of Polish Piorun anti-aircraft missiles, and these are only able to protect certain specific targets.

There have been around three dozen drone incidents in Romania and Moldova since the beginning of August this year. The majority were airspace violations, but there have also been crashes and explosions, while debris has also been found. In Romania, several drones have also been shot down. According to official data, 17 drones crashed in August in Moldova alone – as many as in all of 2025.

There was also a drone strike on the Starokozache border crossing between Ukraine and southeastern...
body.zh: 俄罗斯无人机入侵摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚领空的情况越来越普遍。本周，乌克兰总统的专机被阻止从基希讷乌起飞。观察人士怀疑这些袭击是故意的。 对于乌克兰人来说，俄罗斯的空战多年来一直是痛苦而血腥的现实。乌克兰每天都有人被导弹、炸弹和无人机杀害。但该国的中欧和东南欧邻国也发现自己受到了影响，尽管规模较小：导弹和无人机有时会侵入其领空，有时甚至坠毁在其领土上。 现在，俄罗斯无人机战争正危险地逼近乌克兰的两个邻国：罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦共和国，这两个国家几乎每天都会发生无人机事件。无人机经常爆炸，造成人员受伤，最近摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚边境的乌克兰检查站也发生了袭击事件。 现在，袭击已经升级到了如此程度，以至于许多观察家认为这些袭击不能再被认为是无意的。他们怀疑克里姆林宫故意试图将战争带到乌克兰的邻国。 周二最新的无人机入侵和坠机事件引起了轩然大波，因为它阻止了载有乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的一架飞机在摩尔多瓦首都基希讷乌起飞。一架俄罗斯Geran无人机的飞行速度可达每小时500公里（311英里/小时），从克里米亚起飞，然后飞越乌克兰领空，最终坠毁在摩尔多瓦城市里斯卡尼附近的向日葵田里。 这架无人机还飞越了罗马尼亚上空，两架战斗机从黑海康斯坦察港附近的北约科加尔尼恰努空军基地起飞，不过目前还不清楚为什么他们没有像其他场合那样击落这架无人机。 该事件最严重的方面是，它表明摩尔多瓦防空部队保护该国领空的能力是多么有限。空中交通管制发现并跟踪了这些无人机，但无法将其击落。根据公开信息，波兰仅拥有少量皮奥伦防空导弹，且只能保护某些特定目标。 自今年八月初以来，罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦已发生约三打无人机事件。大多数都是侵犯领空的事件，但也发生过坠机和爆炸事件，同时也发现了碎片。 在罗马尼亚，也有几架无人机被击落。根据官方数据，8 月份仅摩尔多瓦就有 17 架无人机坠毁，这一数字是 2025 年全年的总数量。 乌克兰和东南部之间的斯塔科扎切边境口岸也遭到无人机袭击。

reflection.en: The increasing presence of Russian drones over Moldova and Romania instills fear and uncertainty, disrupting the peace of these neighboring nations. In times of such geopolitical tension and potential threat, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God remains our ultimate refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. Even as the world experiences turmoil, we...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯无人机在摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚上空日益增多的存在，带来了恐惧和不确定性，扰乱了这些邻国的和平。在这样的地缘政治紧张和潜在威胁时期，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们最终的避难所和力量，是在患难中随时的帮助。即使世界经历动荡，我们也能在他同在中找到安慰和稳定。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

While the two nations remain regional rivals, the public display of thawing relations suggests a mutual desire to stabilize the border and cooperate...
summary.zh: 中国国家主席习近平在印度出席金砖国家峰会时受到红地毯欢迎，这被视为中印在2020年发生致命军事冲突后迈向和解的重要一步。尽管两国仍是地区竞争对手，但这种公开的缓和迹象表明，双方都有意稳定边境并在全球舞台上进行合作。

body.en: Chinese president’s arrival in Delhi seen as step towards reconciliation after deadly 2020 military clash The Chinese president, Xi Jinping, has received a red-carpet welcome in India for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi make a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US global dominance. As Xi stepped off the plane, he was walked past an honour guard of Indian soldiers and traditional dancers in colourful dresses. This diplomatic effort reflects the heart of Yahweh, who calls us to live at peace with all people as...

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: BRICS summit leaders urge 'maximum restraint' in Middle East
title.zh: 金砖国家峰会领导人呼吁在中东“保持最大克制”

summary.en: Leaders at the BRICS 2026 summit issued a joint declaration expressing 'deep concern' over Middle East hostilities. Chinese President Xi Jinping stated that the war in Iran was not in the bloc's interest. India and China also committed to normalizing their disputed border.
summary.zh: 在金砖国家2026年峰会上，领导人们发表联合声明，对中东的敌对行动表示“深切关注”。中国国家主席习近平表示，伊朗战争不符合该集团的利益。印度和中国也承诺实现其争议边界的正常化。

body.en:
The joint declaration at the BRICS 2026 summit expressed 'deep concern' over hostilities in the Middle East. China's President Xi Jinping said the Iran war was not in the bloc's interest.

This blog has been paused. Below is a roundup of some of the top headlines from the BRICS Summit 2026 in India on September 12, 2026:

Tired of missing our real-time updates?  Click here to add us as a Preferred Source on Google . Then tap the "Star" or "Preferred" to keep DW News at the top of your feed.

Chinese President Xi Jinping called for Beijing to strengthen its financial cooperation with India during a visit to New Delhi for a BRICS summit.

"Both sides should… work hand-in-hand to promote high-quality major financial cooperation, advocate an equal and sustainable global order, and foster an economic globalization that is open and inclusive," Xi said.

Meanwhile, the Indian Foreign Ministry said that he and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi "underlined the need to address each other's concerns, including structural trade imbalance and supply chain issues, and facilitation of meaningful and predictable market access."

China is India's largest trading partner, with bilateral goods reaching $151 billion (€130 billion) in the financial year of 2025-26.

During this period, India imported $131 billion of goods from China, while India exported some $19 billion worth of goods to its neighbor.

India and China have "expressed commitment" to normalizing their disputed border, India's Foreign Ministry said.

"The two leaders expressed commitment to a fair, reasonable, and mutually acceptable resolution of the boundary question," the ministry said as Chinese President Xi Jinping visits New Delhi for a BRICS summit.

The ministry added the Prime Minister Narendra Modi "underlined the need for both sides to observe existing agreements and understandings on border related issues."

The statement said that Modi stressed that China and India both "must be guided by three mutuals — mutual respect, mutual sensitivity and mutual interest."

Both India and China maintain heavy military deployments along their 3,500 kilometer (2,175-mile) border along Kashmir and Tibet.

Chinese and Indian troops engaged in several skirmishes along the disputed border in 2020 and 2021.

Speaking at the BRICS Summit in New Delhi, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for greater efforts to promote peace in the Middle East and the Gulf region.

"China is willing to work with fellow BRICS members to play due role in achieving peace and stability in the Middle East and the Gulf region," President Xi Jinping told the official Xinhua news agency in New Delhi.

"The war has caused serious losses to people across the region and does not serve the common interests of the international...
body.zh: 金砖国家2026年峰会联合声明表达了对中东敌对行动的“深切关注”。中国国家主席习近平表示，伊朗战争不符合欧盟利益。关注DW了解更多。 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？ 单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 印度外交部表示，印度和中国已“表达承诺”实现有争议的边界正常化。 在中国国家主席习近平访问新德里参加金砖国家峰会时，外交部表示：“两国领导人表示致力于以公平、合理和双方都能接受的方式解决边界问题。” 该部补充说，总理纳伦德拉·莫迪“强调双方需要遵守有关边境相关问题的现有协议和谅解”。 声明称，莫迪强调，中印两国“必须以三个相互为指导——相互尊重、相互敏感和共同利益”。 印度和中国都在克什米尔和西藏长达 3,500 公里（2,175 英里）的边境线上部署了大量军事力量。 2020年和2021年，中国和印度军队在有争议的边境地区发生了几起小冲突。 中国国家主席习近平在新德里金砖国家领导人峰会上发表讲话，呼吁加大力度促进中东海湾地区和平。 “中国愿与金砖国家一道，为实现中东和海湾地区的和平与稳定发挥应有的作用，”习近平主席在新德里对官方新华社表示。 据新华社报道，习近平补充说：“战争给地区人民造成严重损失，不符合国际社会共同利益。” 习近平还指出，强权政治抬头，国际秩序受到挑战，和平安全短板日益增多。他敦促金砖国家必须“站在历史正确的一边”。 金砖国家领导人会晤首日，印度总理莫迪宣布通过联合声明。 金砖国家联盟通过的联合声明呼吁在中东地区保持“最大限度的克制”。 声明中写道：“我们对中东/西亚紧张局势持续升级深表关切，回顾我们各自的国家立场，呼吁保持最大限度的克制，避免采取可能进一步加剧局势的行动。” 成员国重申致力于通过对话、协商和外交和平解决国际争端。 该宣言还倡导采取尊重不同国家的多边方法……

reflection.en: As global leaders gather, their call for 'maximum restraint' in the Middle East echoes the biblical imperative to 'live peaceably with all.' Even amidst complex geopolitical tensions, the pursuit of peace remains a vital endeavor, reflecting a hope for de-escalation and stability.
reflection.zh: 在全球领导人齐聚之际，他们呼吁在中东“保持最大克制”，这呼应了圣经中“务要与人和睦”的命令。即使在复杂的地缘政治紧张局势中，追求和平仍然是一项重要的事业，反映了对缓和局势和实现稳定的希望。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: India's BRICS strategy tested with Xi, Putin set to visit
title.zh: 印度金砖国家战略面临考验，习近平和普京即将访印

summary.en: India's 'America Plus' strategy involves strengthening ties with China and Russia while simultaneously attempting to prevent the BRICS bloc from becoming a platform against the West. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to host the BRICS summit in New Delhi, which will include Chinese President Xi Jinping's first visit...
summary.zh: 印度“美国加”战略涉及加强与中国和俄罗斯的联系，同时试图阻止金砖国家集团成为反西方平台。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将主办金砖国家峰会，中国国家主席习近平自2019年以来首次访印，而印度与华盛顿的关系仍面临挑战。

body.en:
New Delhi's "America Plus" approach sees India deepening its ties with China and Russia, while also trying to keep BRICS from turning into an anti-Western platform.

India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi will host the 18th BRICS summit this weekend in New Delhi, welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to India for the first time since 2019.   

The summit comes at an important moment for India . As New Delhi's year-long BRICS presidency draws to a close, India is stepping up engagement with China and Russia , and its relationship with Washington remains difficult .

Modi met both Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on August 31 and September 1. Just two weeks later, Modi is set to see them again in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.

But with BRICS both growing in size and increasingly troubled by internal divisions, the forum might limit Modi's diplomatic gains.

Indian diplomats are trying to protect their room for maneuver in a changing international order.

Ashok Kantha, a former Indian ambassador to China, said India's engagement with BRICS and the SCO is part of New Delhi's longstanding strategy of strategic autonomy.

"These groupings give India a seat at the table and allow it to pursue its own interests while maintaining relationships with different major powers," Kantha told DW.

However, as Modi prepares to host Xi in New Delhi, ties between India and China are less than ideal .

Both countries reached a border patrol agreement in 2024, ending a four-year military standoff along their disputed frontier.

International flights have resumed, the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage has reopened and some visa restrictions have eased. But major problems remain between Beijing and New Delhi — India is reporting a trade deficit of over $112 billion (€96.5 billion) with China, and the two countries argue over market access.

The Modi-Xi meeting will therefore be watched for signs of a major diplomatic thaw, particularly on trade and investment.

Kantha said the visit could bring some stabilization but should not be mistaken for a reset.

"The border remains heavily militarized and major differences over trade, investment and security remain. India needs a stable and predictable relationship with China, but without lowering its guard," said Kantha.

"It is a relationship of armed coexistence and managed competition. We should not reduce it to a simple 'elephant and dragon' story," he said, referring to traditional symbols of the world's two most populous nations.

India's presidency has already exposed the difficulty of reaching agreement within BRICS, which has grown from its original five members to 11.
