body.zh: 新德里的“美国+”方针让印度加深了与中国和俄罗斯的关系，同时也试图阻止金砖国家变成一个反西方的平台。 印度总理莫迪将于本周末在新德里主办金砖国家领导人第十八次峰会，欢迎中国国家主席习近平自 2019 年以来首次访问印度。 此次峰会对印度来说正值重要时刻。随着新德里为期一年的金砖国家轮值主席国任期接近尾声，印度正在加强与中国和俄罗斯的接触，其与华盛顿的关系仍然困难。 莫迪于8月31日和9月1日在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会上会见了习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。仅仅两周后，莫迪将在新德里出席金砖国家峰会时再次会见他们。 但随着金砖国家规模不断扩大，内部分歧日益困扰，该论坛可能会限制莫迪的外交成果。 印度外交官正试图在不断变化的国际秩序中保护自己的回旋余地。 印度前驻华大使阿肖克·坎塔表示，印度与金砖国家和上合组织的接触是新德里长期战略自主战略的一部分。 坎塔对德国之声表示：“这些组织让印度在谈判桌上占有一席之地，并使其能够在与不同大国保持关系的同时追求自身利益。” 然而，当莫迪准备在新德里接待习近平时，印度和中国之间的关系并不理想。 两国于 2024 年达成边境巡逻协议，结束了两国争议边境长达四年的军事对峙。 国际航班已恢复，神山朝圣活动已重新开放，一些签证限制也已放宽。但北京和新德里之间仍存在重大问题——印度报告的对华贸易逆差超过1120亿美元（965亿欧元），两国在市场准入问题上存在争议。 因此，莫迪与习近平的会晤将受到重大外交解冻的迹象，特别是在贸易和投资方面。 坎塔表示，这次访问可能会带来一些稳定，但不应被误认为是重置。 坎塔表示：“边境仍然高度军事化，贸易、投资和安全方面的重大分歧依然存在。印度需要与中国建立稳定和可预测的关系，但又不能放松警惕。” “这是一种武装共存和有管理的竞争的关系。我们不应将其简化为一个简单的‘象与龙’故事，”他说，他指的是世界上人口最多的两个国家的传统象征。 印度担任轮值主席国已经暴露了金砖国家内部达成协议的难度，金砖国家成员已从最初的5个增加到11个。 与巴西、南非、印度尼西亚等国家...

reflection.en: In a world often defined by division, India's diplomatic approach seeks a delicate balance. The upcoming BRICS summit in New Delhi, with leaders from China and Russia attending, presents an opportunity for dialogue and the pursuit of peace, even amidst complex international relations. May wisdom guide these leaders as they navigate the path toward mutual...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常被分裂所定义的世界上，印度的外交方针寻求微妙的平衡。即将在新德里举行的金砖国家峰会，中国和俄罗斯的领导人将出席，这为对话和寻求和平提供了机会，即使在复杂国际关系中也是如此。愿智慧引导这些领导人，在寻求相互理解与合作的道路上。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: China angered by Taiwan VP's visit to EU democracy forum
title.zh: 中国对台湾副总统访问欧盟民主论坛表示愤怒

summary.en: Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China, and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.
summary.zh: 北京就台湾高级官员访问民主会议一事向意大利和欧盟提出抗议。欧盟正在处理与中国的敏感问题，而台湾高级官员的访问非常罕见。

body.en:
Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.

China was angered by Italy and the EU on Friday, lodging "solemn ‌representations" with both after news broke that high-ranking Taiwanese officials had traveled to the bloc to attend an annual democracy summit.

Beijing's Foreign Ministry said it firmly opposes official interactions of any form with Taiwan by nations who have ties with China .

Solemn ‌representations is a literal translation of a Chinese term expressing diplomatic discontent. 

At issue is a visit by Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung, both of whom were welcomed to the Ventotene Conference for Freedom and Democracy in Italy.

China sees democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, which it has  vowed to "reunite" with the mainland . 

Beijing has previously blasted Hsiao as an "independence diehard" and has criticized her Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) as a separatist outfit.

Taiwan's government has not sought formal independence but Beijing has, nevertheless, threatened to take the island by military force.

European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno announced Hsiao and Lin's attendance at the conference early Friday morning, adding that news of the visit had been kept under wraps until they arrived for safety reasons.

The EU's Picierno, who called the visit a "very important message," was defiant on Friday, saying, "No one can decide who is hosted in Ventotene and who is not," and calling out the Chinese "regime" for seeking to interfere. 

Though Taiwanese foreign ministers travel abroad, it is rare for an official as high-ranking as the vice president to visit nations with ties to Beijing for fear of fallout for host countries.

Other prominent pro-democracy advocates such as Russian Kremlin critic Yulia Navalnaya , the wife of the late Alexei Navalny, and Belarus opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya are also in attendance. 

Italy, like most nations, is not among Taiwan's 12 formal diplomatic allies, although the Vatican is.

Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani will not meet with the visiting Taiwanese officials.

The EU is walking a fine line between democratic support for Taiwan and relations with China.

Beijing's support for Russia in its ongoing invasion of Ukraine — which also prompted Taiwan to seek closer ties with the EU in 2022 — has been a thorn in the side of EU nations and in Brussels.

body.zh: 北京已就台湾高级官员参观民主会议向意大利和欧盟提出投诉。欧盟正在处理与中国有争议的问题，台湾高层访问很少。 周五，意大利和欧盟激怒了中国，在台湾高级官员前往欧盟参加年度民主峰会的消息传出后，中国向意大利和欧盟提出了“严正交涉”。 北京外交部表示，坚决反对与中国有联系的国家与台湾进行任何形式的官方互动。 严正交涉是表达外交不满的中文术语的直译。 争论的焦点是副主席萧美琴和外交部长林家龙的访问，他们两人都受到了意大利文托泰内自由民主会议的欢迎。 中国将民主治理的台湾视为自己的领土，并发誓要与大陆“统一”。 北京此前曾抨击萧是“独立顽固分子”，并批评她所在的民进党（DPP）是分裂主义组织。 台湾政府并未寻求正式独立，但北京却威胁要用武力夺取台湾。 欧洲议会副主席皮娜·皮切尔诺周五凌晨宣布萧和林出席会议，并补充说，出于安全原因，在他们抵达之前，此次访问的消息一直处于保密状态。 欧盟委员皮切尔诺称这次访问是一个“非常重要的信息”，他在周五挑衅地说，“没有人可以决定谁在文托泰内接待，谁不接待”，并指责中国“政权”试图干涉。 尽管台湾外长经常出国访问，但像副总统这样的高级官员很少访问与北京有联系的国家，因为担心对东道国造成影响。 其他著名的民主倡导者，如俄罗斯克里姆林宫批评家尤利娅·纳瓦尔纳亚（已故阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的妻子）和白俄罗斯反对派领导人斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅也出席了会议。 与大多数国家一样，意大利并不在台湾的 12 个正式外交盟友之列，但梵蒂冈却在其中。 意大利外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼不会会见来访的台湾官员。 欧盟在对台湾的民主支持和与中国的关系之间保持着微妙的平衡。 北京对俄罗斯持续入侵乌克兰的支持——这也促使台湾在 2022 年寻求与欧盟建立更紧密的关系——一直是欧盟国家和布鲁塞尔的眼中钉。 如果您依赖我们团队提供值得信赖的报告，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终看到...

reflection.en: Diplomatic tensions often arise from differing political views and national interests. In these moments, the call to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us, is a vital reminder for nations and individuals alike. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and mutual respect.
reflection.zh: 外交紧张局势常常源于不同的政治观点和国家利益。在这些时刻，尽我们所能与人和睦相处的呼吁，对国家和个人来说都是一个重要的提醒。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和相互尊重。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists jailed for up to 7 years
title.zh: 香港天安门事件纪念活动组织者被判监禁，刑期最长七年

summary.en: Three pro-democracy activists in Hong Kong have been sentenced to between five and seven years in prison under the city's national security law for organizing annual commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen crackdown. The Hong Kong Alliance, the group they were part of, was also fined.
summary.zh: 香港三名亲民主活动人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压事件的年度活动，根据该市的国家安全法被判处五年至七年监禁。他们所属的香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会（支联会）也被处以罚款。

body.en:
Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were charged under Hong Kong's Beijing-backed national security law.

A Hong Kong court on Friday sentenced three pro-democracy activists who organized annual vigils marking China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown to between five and seven years in prison under the city's national security law .

The three were convicted in August of "incitement to subversion" over their activities with the now-disbanded Hong Kong Alliance, which received a fine of HK$1.5 million ($191,304, €164,768). The alliance had organized annual Tiananmen vigils in Victoria Park.

Judges cited the group's call to "end one-party dictatorship," saying it challenged the legitimacy of Communist Party rule in the Chinese special administrative region. 

Lee and Chow denied the subversion charges under Hong Kong's controversial national security law. The defendants also insisted the alliance had not asked people to do anything illegal. 

The court rejected arguments that the defendants believed they were acting within the law given Hong ​Kong's freedoms of speech, which have been severely curtailed since Beijing imposed the law in 2020 following a crackdown mass pro-democracy protests the previous year.

The vigils, once a major annual event in Hong Kong, have been effectively banned under the law. 

Chow, a barrister who represented herself, raised both arms and waved at supporters as she was escorted out.

Her mother, Medina Chow, addressed her supporters saying, "For today's verdict, you do not need to be overly saddened. Do not lose heart. And above all, do not ​feel guilty."

The convictions have drawn criticism from foreign governments and rights groups.

"This sentencing is a triple tragedy: for the activists being unjustly punished; the survivors and victims of the Tiananmen crackdown itself; and the generations of Hongkongers denied the space to discuss one of the most consequential events in modern Chinese history," said Amnesty International's deputy regional director, Sarah Brooks.

Germany and France last month had condemned the verdict against Chow saying that "peaceful advocacy for human rights does not constitute a crime."

Among those arrested under the security law are pro-democracy former media tycoon Jimmy Lai and former student leader Joshua Wong .

body.zh: 三名民主活动人士因每年组织纪念 1989 年中国致命的天安门镇压活动而受到北京支持的香港国家安全法的指控。 香港一家法院周五根据香港国家安全法判处三名民主活动人士五年至七年监禁，这些活动人士每年组织纪念中国 1989 年天安门镇压事件的守夜活动。 三人于 8 月因与现已解散的香港联盟的活动而被判“煽动颠覆”罪，该联盟被罚款 150 万港元（191,304 美元，164,768 欧元）。该联盟在维多利亚公园组织了一年一度的天安门守夜活动。 法官援引该组织“结束一党专政”的呼吁，称其挑战了共产党在中国特别行政区统治的合法性。 李和周否认了根据香港有争议的国家安全法提出的颠覆罪指控。被告还坚称联盟没有要求人们做任何非法的事情。 鉴于香港的言论自由自去年镇压大规模民主抗议活动后北京于 2020 年实施该法律以来，香港的言论自由受到严重限制，法院驳回了被告认为自己在法律范围内行事的论点。 守夜活动曾经是香港的一项重大年度活动，但实际上已被法律禁止。 周女士是一名代表自己的大律师，她在被护送出去时举起双臂向支持者挥手致意。 她的母亲周美娜对她的支持者说：“对于今天的判决，你们不必过度悲伤。不要灰心。最重要的是，不要感到内疚。” 这些定罪引起了外国政府和人权组织的批评。 国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“这一判决是一场三重悲剧：活动人士受到不公正的惩罚；天安门镇压本身的幸存者和受害者；几代香港人被剥夺了讨论中国现代历史上最重要事件之一的空间。” 德国和法国上个月谴责了对周的判决，称“和平倡导人权并不构成犯罪”。 根据国安法被捕的人包括民主派前媒体大亨黎智英和前学生领袖黄之锋。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: These activists faced severe penalties for organizing commemorations of the Tiananmen crackdown, an act rooted in remembering historical events and advocating for democratic values. Their imprisonment under the national security law raises profound questions about conscience, obedience to authority, and the courage to stand for deeply held beliefs, even at...
reflection.zh: 这些活动人士因组织纪念天安门事件的活动而面临严厉处罚，这些活动根植于铭记历史事件和倡导民主价值观。他们根据国安法被监禁，引发了关于良心、服从权威以及即使付出巨大个人代价也要坚持坚定信念的勇气的深刻问题。当人的律法与道德信念发生冲突时，服从上帝的原则是此类良心行为的核心。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

reflection.en: As leaders gather for the BRICS summit, the shadow of ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East looms large. The gathering presents an opportunity for dialogue, a crucial step in the difficult pursuit of peace. May these leaders seek paths toward de-escalation and reconciliation, remembering that true strength lies in building bridges rather than...
reflection.zh: 随着各国领导人齐聚金砖国家峰会，乌克兰和中东地区持续的冲突阴影笼罩着会议。这次聚会提供了一个对话的机会，这是在艰难寻求和平过程中至关重要的一步。愿这些领导人寻求缓和局势与和解的道路，并铭记真正的力量在于搭建桥梁而非加深分歧。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

body.en: French company Puy du Fou is planning a £600m history-themed park in Oxfordshire. A Guardian investigation has found the company continued working with associates of Konstantin Malofeyev, a pro-Kremlin oligarch under sanctions, on plans for a theme park in Russian-occupied Crimea for longer than it had previously disclosed, and later explored projects in Iran and China. Business reporter Rob Davies explains his findings, including documents that raise questions about whether Puy du Fou’s activities tested the limits of EU sanctions imposed after Russia’s 2014 annexation of Crimea. He also examines the far-right politics associated with Puy du Fou’s founder, Philippe de Villiers, and asks whether the company is a suitable choice to tell Britain’s national story Kremlin connections: the Russia links to a £600m UK theme park Continue reading...
body.zh: 法国公司 Puy du Fou 正计划在牛津郡建造一座价值 6 亿英镑的历史主题公园。 《卫报》的一项调查发现，该公司继续与受到制裁的亲克里姆林宫寡头康斯坦丁·马洛费耶夫 (Konstantin Malofeyev) 的同事在俄罗斯占领的克里米亚建造主题公园的计划比之前披露的时间要长，后来又探索了伊朗和中国的项目。商业记者罗布·戴维斯 (Rob Davies) 解释了他的调查结果，其中包括一些文件，这些文件引发了人们的疑问：Puy du Fou 的活动是否测试了俄罗斯 2014 年吞并克里米亚后实施的欧盟制裁的限度。他还研究了与 Puy du Fou 创始人 Philippe de Villiers 相关的极右政治，并询问该公司是否适合讲述英国的国家故事克里姆林宫的联系：俄罗斯与价值 6 亿英镑的英国主题公园有联系继续阅读...

It prompts reflection on the ethical responsibilities of global businesses, urging them to act justly and with integrity, even when navigating complex geopolitical landscapes. The pursuit of profit should not overshadow the...
reflection.zh: 这篇报道引发了对一家公司在被占领土进行商业交易及其与受制裁个人之间联系的担忧。它促使人们反思全球企业的道德责任，敦促它们即使在复杂的政治环境中也要公正行事，并保持诚信。追求利润不应压倒以公平的方式开展业务并避免卷入可疑活动的必要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Their kids have never seen their arm': The tattoos people are desperate to remove
title.zh: 后悔的17.9亿美元生意

summary.en: Tattoos were once considered permanent, but a growing industry now offers removal services. Mike Anderson, unable to find a clinic, opened his own, which has since expanded into a multi-location business, reflecting a shift in attitudes towards permanence.
summary.zh: 纹身曾被认为是永久的，但如今一个不断发展的行业提供了去除服务。迈克·安德森在找不到诊所后，自己开了一家，该诊所现已扩展为跨多地的业务，反映了人们对永久性的态度转变。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

But when Mike Anderson decided he no longer wanted his ink, he discovered just how difficult it was to undo the permanence.

Unable to find a laser tattoo-removal clinic in Sydney's inner-west, he and his wife decided to open one themselves.

Twelve years later, what began as a personal solution has grown into a business spanning 12 locations across NSW, Queensland and the United States — part of a booming industry built around a simple idea: what goes on the skin doesn't necessarily have to stay there.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

With more than a decade in the industry, Anderson says he has seen his fair share of tattoo regret stories .

"There was one from Bondi that said 'chicken' when they thought it said 'prosper'."

Anderson says the rise of fine-line and highly detailed tattoos has brought a new group of clients into removal clinics .

"With more detail comes more opportunity for mistakes and bad work. When they go wrong, they usually go noticeably wrong."

The growing demand for a second chance at unwanted ink is fuelling a booming global industry. The tattoo-removal market was worth an estimated US$1.29 billion ($1.79 billion) in 2025 and is forecast to reach US$4.87 billion ($6.75 billion) by 2034, according to Fortune Business Insights.

For some clients, the tattoos they want removed carry a darker history — racist symbols, hate-related words and, in some cases, racist slogans.

For five years, Anderson's clinic has run a charity program offering free removal of these tattoos.

"We've done al-Qaeda tattoos, we've done swastikas and white power symbols," he says.

Anderson says the aim is to help clients distance themselves from the beliefs these tattoos represent.

"The idea is that we take those tattoos and break the chain of influence, like, nephews, sons [and] daughters are less likely to fall into those same paths."

Anderson says the program attracts a high volume of applicants, but clients must demonstrate genuine remorse.

"We judge it on a case-by-case basis. We ask questions about the crimes they've committed; we expect transparency.

"They have to tell us what it means to them; are they looking to get employed? And make sure they're the right person."

Today's tattoo removal industry is part of a much longer story: how tattooing evolved from a practice associated with particular communities and subcultures into mainstream body art.

The State Library of Victoria estimates around a quarter of convicts sent to Australia had at least one tattoo.

title.en: Australian scientists say they'll have a live Tasmanian tiger by 2036
title.zh: 澳大利亚科学家称将在2036年复活袋狼

summary.en: Advanced genetic engineering aims to resurrect the extinct thylacine ahead of the 100th anniversary of its loss.
summary.zh: 先进的基因工程旨在在已灭绝的袋狼消失100周年之际将其复活。

body.en:
Scientists hoping to catch a tiger by the gene trail are on the verge of creating a live thylacine before the 100th anniversary of the death of the last-known specimen famously filmed in a zoo.

Using advanced genetics, international scientists are working to bring the legendary marsupial back from extinction.

This week marked the 90th anniversary of the death of the last Tasmanian Tiger in Hobart on September 7, 1936.

The marsupial, an apex predator that once roamed the Australian mainland, was wiped out in its last stronghold by European hunters, habitat destruction and disease.

Drawing on thylacine remains in museums and universities, researchers have already pieced together a full genome in a step toward reviving the species.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Given the progress, lead geneticist for the project at Melbourne University, Professor Andrew Pask, is very hopeful a live thylacine can walk the Earth again in 2036.

Four years ago, he teamed with Colossal Biosciences in the US, and now a large team of scientists is focused on bringing the tiger back, with the technology well advanced and pushing boundaries.

Genetic engineering and editing were now possible at scale, and artificial intelligence helped further, Pask said — the first scientist to put a thylacine gene into a mouse and make it work.

When a full genome is sequenced, it's a matter of finding the closest living relative to the extinct species.

In the case of the thylacine, that's a tiny marsupial called the Fat-tailed Dunnart, which is about 99.8 per cent genetically identical to the tiger.

Gene-editing tools are then used to change every bit of code where the dunnart differs from the thylacine, with cloning employed using an egg from a donor dunnart.

"That's part of the technology we're working on at the moment; how we clone, how we take a cell and create a whole animal from it in marsupials," Pask said.

"You build up over time, get closer and closer to live DNA cells of the thylacine. We're in that process now of making all of those edits."

Researchers were also becoming proficient at artificial DNA synthesis, meaning future gene editing could be bypassed, and a thylacine genome could be synthesised.

A dunnart would have no problem birthing a thylacine because the newborn tiger would only be about the size of a grain of rice, Pask said.

"It could probably survive in Mum's pouch for about two weeks so it would get that early milk ... then you would remove it and just hand-rear it from then on."

Pask said thylacines with slightly different DNA would be produced to ensure diversity and a healthy breeding population.

body.zh: 在动物园拍摄的最后一个已知标本死亡 100 周年之前，希望通过基因追踪捕获老虎的科学家们即将培育出活体袋狼。 国际科学家正在利用先进的遗传学技术，努力使这种传奇的有袋动物免于灭绝。 本周是最后一只塔斯马尼亚虎于 1936 年 9 月 7 日在霍巴特死亡 90 周年。 这种有袋动物是一种曾经在澳大利亚大陆上游荡的顶级掠食者，但由于欧洲猎人、栖息地破坏和疾病，它的最后一个据点被消灭了。 研究人员利用博物馆和大学中的袋狼遗骸，拼凑出了完整的基因组，朝着复兴该物种迈出了一步。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 鉴于这一进展，墨尔本大学该项目的首席遗传学家 Andrew Pask 教授非常希望活袋狼能够在 2036 年再次出现在地球上。 四年前，他与美国 Colossal Biosciences 合作，现在一大批科学家正致力于利用先进的技术并突破界限，将老虎带回来。 帕斯克说，基因工程和编辑现在已经可以大规模实现，而人工智能则提供了进一步的帮助——他是第一个将袋狼基因放入小鼠体内并使其发挥作用的科学家。 当对完整基因组进行测序时，问题就是找到与灭绝物种最接近的现存物种。 以袋狼为例，它是一种名为“肥尾袋鹬”的小型有袋动物，与老虎的基因相似度约为 99.8%。 然后，基因编辑工具被用来改变袋貂与袋狼不同的每一个代码，并使用捐赠者的卵子进行克隆。 “这是我们目前正在研究的技术的一部分；我们如何克隆，如何在有袋动物中提取细胞并从中创造出完整的动物，”帕斯克说。 “随着时间的推移，你会越来越接近袋狼的活 DNA 细胞。我们现在正处于进行所有这些编辑的过程中。” 研究人员也变得精通人工 DNA 合成，这意味着未来的基因编辑可以被绕过，并且可以合成袋狼基因组。 帕斯克说，袋老虎生下袋狼是没有问题的，因为新生的老虎只有一粒米那么大。 “它可能会在妈妈的育儿袋里存活大约两周，这样它就会得到早期的牛奶……然后你就可以把它取出来，从那时起就用手抚养它。” 帕斯克说，将生产DNA略有不同的袋狼，以确保多样性和健康的繁殖种群。 野生老虎不需要......

reflection.en: The ambition to bring back the Tasmanian tiger, extinct for nearly a century, highlights humanity's fascination with life's intricate design. It prompts reflection on the marvel of creation, even as we explore the frontiers of genetic science. The Psalmist's awe at being 'fearfully and wonderfully made' resonates with the deep wonder inherent in...
reflection.zh: 复活近一个世纪以来已灭绝的袋狼的雄心，凸显了人类对生命精妙设计的着迷。它促使我们反思造物的奇妙，即使在我们探索基因科学前沿之时。诗人对“我被造而奇妙可畏”的惊叹，与理解和操纵生命本身所固有的深刻惊奇产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Middle East shipping escalation about to hit every Australian wallet
title.zh: 中东航运升级恐将冲击每个澳大利亚人的钱包

summary.en: Australians are facing persistently high fuel prices, with regular unleaded expected to remain around $2.11 per liter, due to escalating conflict in the Middle East. Attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have driven global oil prices above $100 per barrel, leading to significant price hikes at the pump in...
summary.zh: 由于中东冲突升级，澳大利亚人正面临持续的高油价，普通无铅汽油预计将维持在每升2.11美元左右。霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭事件已将全球油价推高至每桶100美元以上，导致澳大利亚加油站价格大幅上涨，并引发了对通货膨胀加剧以及澳大利亚储备银行可能加息的担忧。

body.en:
Australians are being warned that high fuel prices are likely to stay as the war in the Middle East reaches dangerous new levels of escalation.

As the US-led war on Iran shows no signs of ending and oil tankers are being targeted and sunk in the Strait of Hormuz by both sides, global oil prices have surged above US $100 ($139.5) a barrel.

This has led to fuel prices in Australia jumping at the bowser to an average price for regular unleaded of $2.11, a massive increase from $1.55 in July.

The surging prices are sparking inflation fears and raising concerns that the Reserve Bank of Australia will lift the cash rate when the monetary policy board meets again at the end of September .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"It really depends exclusively, almost, on what's going to happen in the Middle East," he said.

"We've seen dangerous levels of escalation in the last few days, so you've got the situation where they're blowing up each other's oil tankers in the ocean, so that doesn't help."

In response to soaring prices at the start of the conflict in the Middle East in March, the Albanese government temporarily halved the fuel excise in April, slashing 26 cents off a litre.

A scaled-back extension of the fuel excise was reduced to 16 cents per litre for petrol and diesel, which lasted until 2 August.

Khoury said the government keeping its options open remained the best approach to the unfolding crisis.

"Even though the average price for unleaded nationally is $2.11, in April it was $2.60, and that was at that point when the government cut the excise," he said.

"It is obviously expensive, more expensive than we want it to be, but it's nowhere near those levels."

Khoury urged motorists to check fuel prices in real-time and shop around for savings when filling up.

About one fifth of the world's oil transits through the Strait of Hormuz, with fighting between the two countries centring on control for the key shipping route.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 澳大利亚人被警告称，随着中东战争升级到危险的新水平，高油价可能会持续下去。 由于美国领导的伊朗战争没有结束的迹象，而且双方都在霍尔木兹海峡瞄准并击沉油轮，全球油价已飙升至每桶 100 美元（139.5 美元）以上。 这导致澳大利亚的普通无铅汽油平均价格大幅上涨至 2.11 美元，较 7 月份的 1.55 美元大幅上涨。 物价飙升引发了通胀担忧，并引发了人们对澳大利亚储备银行将在9月底再次召开货币政策委员会会议时提高现金利率的担忧。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “这几乎完全取决于中东将要发生的事情，”他说。 “过去几天我们看到局势升级到了危险的程度，所以现在的情况是他们在海上互相炸毁对方的油轮，所以这于事无补。” 为了应对 3 月份中东冲突开始时价格飙升的情况，阿尔巴尼亚政府于 4 月份暂时将燃油消费税减半，每升削减 26 美分。 汽油和柴油的燃油消费税缩减至每升 16 美分，一直持续到 8 月 2 日。 库里表示，政府保留选择余地仍然是应对正在发生的危机的最佳方法。 “尽管全国无铅汽油的平均价格为 2.11 美元，但 4 月份的价格为 2.60 美元，而当时政府削减了消费税，”他说。 “这显然很贵，比我们想要的更贵，但还远未达到这些水平。” Khoury 敦促驾车者实时查看燃油价格，并在加油时货比三家以节省费用。 世界上大约五分之一的石油通过霍尔木兹海峡运输，两国之间的战斗围绕着对这条重要航线的控制权展开。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The escalating conflict in the Middle East, with attacks on oil tankers, has a ripple effect reaching Australian wallets, pushing fuel prices to $2.11 per liter. This situation underscores how distant conflicts disrupt daily life and economic stability, reminding us of the interconnectedness of global peace and prosperity. May we pray for those affected by...
reflection.zh: 中东地区冲突的升级，包括油轮遇袭事件，正通过油价推升至每升2.11美元，直接影响到澳大利亚人的钱包。这一局面凸显了遥远的冲突如何扰乱日常生活和经济稳定，提醒我们全球和平与繁荣的相互关联。愿我们为受暴力影响的人们祈祷，并为和平的迅速回归祈求，使此类动荡得以停止。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Fixing Australia's immigration system is not just about cutting migrants
title.zh: 可能让澳大利亚陷入困境的数字，如果我们处理不当

summary.en: Australians want immigration changes to improve the country, but they need to be done the right way. After the COVID-19 pandemic, the number of migrants flowing into Australia increased to "unbelievable levels," says immigration expert Abul Rizvi. Numbers had fallen sharply during the pandemic years as lockdown...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚人希望通过移民改革来改善国家，但改革必须以正确的方式进行。移民专家阿布尔·里兹维表示，在新冠疫情大流行之后，流入澳大利亚的移民数量达到了“令人难以置信的水平”。在疫情期间，由于封锁措施限制了国际旅行，移民人数急剧下降。到2021年3月，季度移民抵达人数已降至疫情前水平的五分之一。前移民部副部长里兹维表示，没有人...

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

After the COVID-19 pandemic, the number of migrants flowing into Australia increased to "unbelievable levels", says immigration expert Abul Rizvi.

Numbers had fallen sharply during the pandemic years as lockdown measures halted international travel. By March 2021, quarterly migrant arrivals had dropped to a fifth of pre-pandemic levels in Australia.

Rizvi, a former deputy secretary at the Department of Immigration, says no one was expecting net overseas migration (NOM) — which also factors in migrant departures — to reach a record annual high of almost 550,000 people as it did in 2023.

Almost three years later, Australia is still adjusting to that influx, and politicians across the ideological divide are now fixated on setting a new figure.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The recent debate over Australia's NOM has been dominated by One Nation, which is calling for substantial cuts to immigration.

But research shows that opposition to immigration is often concentrated in areas with the fewest migrants.

Experts say these areas could also be among the worst hit by wide-ranging cuts, such as those proposed by One Nation.

Temporary migrants have historically been a driver of population growth in Australia. Typically, more migrants arrive each year than those who leave, increasing the overall population over time.

One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has accused Labor of using migration to prop up headline economic numbers, saying in a media release: "Australians pay the price through lower wages, higher rents, unaffordable homes and stretched services."

To address these issues, Hanson says the number of migrants should be reduced, insisting that "international student numbers must be slashed". She has also called for the skilled migration program to be more targeted, and immigration from countries on the 'Do Not Travel' list to be halted.

The latest Department of Home Affairs figures show 2.9 million temporary visa holders were living in Australia on 31 July 2026.

The largest single group was New Zealanders holding 'special category visas', which accounted for 20 per cent (736,509) of temporary visa holders.

Temporary visa holders, who also include tourists or those undertaking short-term work or study, are not considered migrants by the ABS unless they are in the country for longer than a year.

Global migration expert and associate professor at the University of Sydney, Anna Boucher, says some temporary visa holders are still in Australia due to decisions made by former governments, including extensions granted after the pandemic...
body.zh: 分享您的反馈并帮助我们改进此功能。请在此处详细了解我们如何在 SBS 使用人工智能。 移民专家阿布尔·里兹维 (Abul Rizvi) 表示，在 COVID-19 大流行之后，流入澳大利亚的移民人数增加到“令人难以置信的水平”。 在大流行期间，由于封锁措施阻止了国际旅行，人数急剧下降。到 2021 年 3 月，澳大利亚每季度的移民人数已下降至疫情爆发前水平的五分之一。 移民部前副部长里兹维表示，没有人预计净海外移民 (NOM)——这也是移民出境的一个因素——会像 2023 年那样达到近 55 万人的年度新高。 近三年后，澳大利亚仍在适应这种涌入，跨越意识形态分歧的政治家现在专注于设定一个新的数字。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 最近关于澳大利亚 NOM 的争论主要由一国党主导，该党呼吁大幅削减移民。 但研究表明，反对移民的声音往往集中在移民最少的地区。 专家表示，这些地区也可能是受到大范围削减（例如一国集团提议的削减）打击最严重的地区之一。 历史上，临时移民一直是澳大利亚人口增长的推动力。通常，每年到达的移民多于离开的移民，随着时间的推移，总人口不断增加。 一国党领袖保琳·汉森指责工党利用移民来支撑总体经济数据，她在一份媒体新闻稿中表示：“澳大利亚人通过较低的工资、较高的租金、难以负担的住房和紧张的服务付出了代价。” 为了解决这些问题，汉森表示应该减少移民人数，并坚称“必须削减国际学生人数”。她还呼吁提高技术移民计划的针对性，并停止来自“禁止旅行”名单上国家的移民。 内政部的最新数据显示，截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日，有 290 万临时签证持有者居住在澳大利亚。 最大的单一群体是持有“特殊类别签证”的新西兰人，占临时签证持有者的 20%（736,509 人）。 临时签证持有者（也包括游客或进行短期工作或学习的人）除非在该国停留超过一年，否则不会被 ABS 视为移民。 全球移民专家、悉尼大学副教授安娜·鲍彻 (Anna Boucher) 表示，由于前政府做出的决定，包括疫情后批准的延期，一些临时签证持有者仍在澳大利亚。

The principle of welcoming the foreigner, as taught in Deuteronomy, calls for treating those who come to our land with justice and compassion, recognizing their inherent dignity. As nations navigate complex migration patterns, may...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚正经历着大量移民涌入的局面，这种情况需要审慎的管理和考量。申命记中教导的欢迎外国人的原则，要求我们以公正和怜悯之心对待来到我们土地上的人们，并认识到他们固有的尊严。当各国应对复杂的移民模式时，愿领导者和公民都能寻求智慧，促进融合与相互尊重。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Could Australia's housing downturn push the economy into recession?
title.zh: 澳大利亚房价下跌是否会将经济推入衰退？

summary.en: Falling house prices could slow spending and growth, but economists say a housing-led recession is far from certain.
summary.zh: 房价下跌可能会减缓支出和增长，但经济学家表示，由住房市场引发的衰退远非必然。

body.en:
Australians have watched the value of their homes soar for years. Now, as prices head in the opposite direction, there are warnings the fallout could spread well beyond the property market.

Property developer Nigel Satterley has warned Australia could face a "full-blown recession" if the housing downturn spills into consumer spending, as falling property values leave households feeling poorer and less willing to spend.

The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) has pushed back on those fears, acknowledging the downturn will slow parts of the economy but saying it does not currently expect a recession.

Independent economist Saul Eslake agrees with the RBA that the housing downturn is likely to slow economic growth, but says falling property prices alone are unlikely to be enough to push Australia into recession.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I don't think a decline in property prices of the orders of magnitude that people are now talking about ... that is to say, maybe of the order of 10, perhaps in some cities 15 per cent over a one or two-year period, I don't think that on its own would precipitate a recession," he said.

"It would certainly contribute at the margin to some slowing in economic growth."

AMP Chief Economist Shane Oliver also believes a recession is not the most likely outcome, but sees a greater risk that the housing downturn could contribute to one if prices continue falling and the broader economy weakens.

"Recession isn't my base case, but the risk is significant," he said, putting the probability at around 30 per cent and rising.

Put simply, when the value of an asset such as a home rises, people can feel wealthier and become more comfortable spending. When its value falls, the opposite can happen.

Oliver said previous RBA analysis suggested a 10 per cent fall in house prices could reduce consumer spending by about 0.8 per cent after six months and 1.6 per cent over the longer term.

That matters because household consumption makes up a significant portion of economic activity.

"If the economy is weak enough to start with because of higher interest rates and other things, then that could potentially knock us into recession because the consumer is about 60 per cent of the economy," Oliver said.

But Eslake said the relationship between property values and spending was not necessarily straightforward.

For most Australians who own only the home they live in, he said its value was largely "paper wealth" unless they sold.

If someone is selling to buy another property, falling prices also mean the home they are moving into is likely to be cheaper.

Earlier this week, RBA assistant governor Sarah Hunter also said the impact of...
body.zh: 多年来，澳大利亚人见证了自己房屋价值的飙升。现在，随着价格朝着相反的方向发展，有人警告称，其影响可能会远远超出房地产市场。 房地产开发商奈杰尔·萨特利(Nigel Satterley)警告称，如果房地产市场低迷蔓延到消费者支出，澳大利亚可能面临“全面衰退”，因为房价下跌会让家庭感觉更穷，更不愿意花钱。 澳大利亚储备银行（RBA）反驳了这些担忧，承认经济低迷将放缓部分经济，但表示目前预计不会出现衰退。 独立经济学家索尔·埃斯莱克（Saul Eslake）同意澳大利亚央行的观点，即房地产市场低迷可能会减缓经济增长，但他表示，仅房地产价格下跌不太可能足以将澳大利亚推入衰退。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他表示：“我认为房地产价格的下降幅度不会像人们现在谈论的那样......也就是说，在一两年内可能下降 10％，在某些城市可能下降 15％，我认为这本身不会引发经济衰退。” “这肯定会在一定程度上导致经济增长放缓。” AMP 首席经济学家肖恩·奥利弗 (Shane Oliver) 也认为，经济衰退并不是最有可能的结果，但他认为，如果价格继续下跌且整体经济疲软，房地产市场低迷可能会导致经济衰退的风险更大。 “经济衰退不是我的基本情况，但风险很大，”他说，他认为这种可能性在 30% 左右，而且还在上升。 简而言之，当房屋等资产的价值上升时，人们会感觉更富有，消费也更放心。当其价值下降时，可能会发生相反的情况。 奥利弗表示，此前澳洲联储的分析表明，房价下跌10%可能会在六个月后减少消费者支出约0.8%，从长远来看会减少1.6%。 这很重要，因为家庭消费占经济活动的很大一部分。 奥利弗表示：“如果由于利率上升和其他因素导致经济一开始就足够疲软，那么我们可能会陷入衰退，因为消费者约占经济的 60%。” 但埃斯莱克表示，房地产价值和支出之间的关系并不一定是直接的。 他表示，对于大多数只拥有自己居住的房屋的澳大利亚人来说，除非他们出售，否则房屋的价值主要是“纸面财富”。 如果有人出售房产以购买另一处房产，价格下跌也意味着他们搬入的房屋可能会更便宜。 本周早些时候，澳大利亚央行助理行长萨拉·亨特还表示……

reflection.en: As property values decline in Australia, households may feel less wealthy, leading to reduced spending. This economic principle echoes the ancient wisdom of Proverbs 22:7, which warns that 'the borrower is slave to the lender.' When asset values fall, the perceived wealth and financial security of homeowners can diminish, impacting their willingness to...
reflection.zh: 随着澳大利亚房价下跌，家庭可能会感到财富缩水，从而减少支出。这一经济现象呼应了古老的智慧，《箴言》22:7 警告说：“欠债的是债主的仆人。”当资产价值下降时，房主的财富和财务安全感可能会减弱，影响他们的消费和投资意愿。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: How to solve Hong Kong’s triple whammy: ageing population, baby dearth and job losses?
title.zh: 香港如何解决人口老龄化、生育率低和失业的三重困境？

summary.en: This article previews a forthcoming policy address, analyzing how to improve livelihoods in Hong Kong by addressing demographic shifts and technological advancements. It features a 28-year-old resident who, despite wanting a child with his wife, cannot afford one on his current income of HK$10,000 per month.

body.en: In the fourth of our series of previews on the five-year plan and policy address, to be announced on September 16, Fiona Sun and Edith Lin analyse how to improve livelihoods in the city by tackling the impact of demographic changes and technological advancement. Read part one here, part two here and part three here. Twenty-eight-year-old Hong Kong resident Fong and his wife want to have a child but he knows they cannot afford one for now. He earns about HK$10,000 (US$1,275) a month as a...
body.zh: 在我们将于 9 月 16 日公布的五年计划和施政报告系列预览的第四期中，孙菲奥娜和林伊迪丝分析了如何通过应对人口变化和技术进步的影响来改善城市的民生。在这里阅读第一部分，在这里阅读第二部分，在这里阅读第三部分。 28 岁的香港居民方先生和他的妻子想要一个孩子，但他知道他们暂时买不起。作为一名...，他每月的收入约为 10,000 港元（1,275 美元）。

reflection.en: The desire for children is a deep human longing, yet for many, like the young couple in Hong Kong, economic realities create significant barriers. This passage reminds us that children are a gift from Yahweh, a blessing that transcends financial calculations. May we pray for policies and a society that supports families and recognizes the profound value of...
reflection.zh: 渴望拥有孩子是一种深刻的人类愿望，但对许多人来说，就像香港的年轻夫妇一样，经济现实构成了重大障碍。这段经文提醒我们，孩子是雅伟的恩赐，是一种超越财务计算的祝福。愿我们为支持家庭的政策和社会祈祷，并认识到每个孩子的深远价值。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: 39 pupils and staff fall ill after eating school lunches in Sha Tin
title.zh: 沙田小学午餐疑致39名学童及教职员不适

summary.en: Hong Kong health authorities are investigating a suspected food poisoning outbreak affecting 39 pupils and staff members at Baptist (Sha Tin Wai) Lui Ming Choi Primary School. The affected individuals, aged five to 38, developed symptoms like stomach pain and diarrhea hours after consuming school lunches provided by a...
summary.zh: 香港卫生当局正在调查一起疑似食物中毒事件，该事件导致沙田浸信（沙田围）吕明才小学的39名学童及教职员不适。受影响者年龄介于5至38岁之间，在周三食用供应商提供的学校午餐数小时后出现腹痛和腹泻等症状。

body.en: Hong Kong health authorities are investigating an outbreak of suspected food poisoning that hit 39 pupils and staff members who ate lunch at a Sha Tin school earlier this week. Twenty-three boys and 14 girls, aged between five and 11, from Baptist (Sha Tin Wai) Lui Ming Choi Primary School and two employees, aged 34 and 38, were affected. They developed stomach pain and diarrhoea about eight to 22 hours after eating school lunches provided by a supplier on Wednesday. A spokesman for the school,...
body.zh: 香港卫生当局正在调查本周早些时候在沙田一所学校吃午餐的 39 名学生和教职员工疑似食物中毒事件。浸信会（沙田围）吕明才小学的二十三名男童和十四名女童，年龄介乎五岁至十一岁，以及两名雇员，年龄分别为三十四岁和三十八岁。周三，他们在吃完供应商提供的学校午餐后约 8 至 22 小时出现胃痛和腹泻。学校发言人表示...

reflection.en: It is deeply concerning when children and those who care for them fall ill, especially from something as basic as a school meal. This incident calls us to pray for the swift recovery of all affected and for wisdom for the authorities investigating the cause. May Yahweh's healing presence be felt by those suffering, and may such incidents be prevented in the...
reflection.zh: 当孩子们和照顾他们的人患病时，尤其是在食用学校餐点后出现不适，这令人深感担忧。这一事件促使我们为所有受影响者的康复祈祷，并为调查原因的当局祈求智慧。愿雅伟的医治同在临到受苦者，愿此类事件在未来得以避免。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Quality concerns prompt further tests on concrete used in 3 public housing blocks

The main contractor, Able Engineering, is also involved in a scandal regarding defective lift installation at Queen Mary Hospital. Regular...
summary.zh: 香港房屋委员会透露，在东涌三个正在兴建的公共房屋地块中使用的混凝土质量需要进一步检测和审查。该项目的主要承包商能兴工程也卷入了玛丽医院扩建项目电梯安装缺陷丑闻。例行检查发现了混凝土存在问题。

According to official documents, the main contractor on the project is Able Engineering. The same company is also involved in a scandal over defective lift installation work at an expansion project at Queen Mary Hospital in Pok Fu Lam. The authority said on Saturday that regular checks had uncovered issues with...
body.zh: 香港房屋委员会透露，东涌正在建设的公共屋村三座所用混凝土的质量需要进一步测试和审查。根据官方文件，该项目的主要承包商是Able Engineering。该公司还卷入薄扶林玛丽医院扩建工程电梯安装工程缺陷丑闻。该机构周六表示，定期检查发现了以下问题...

reflection.en: When public trust is placed in builders and contractors, the integrity of their work is paramount. The discovery of potential issues with concrete in new housing blocks in Tung Chung raises questions about accountability and the ethical standards expected in construction. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving...
reflection.zh: 当公众信任被寄予建筑商和承包商时，他们工作的诚信至关重要。在东涌新住房地块中发现的混凝土潜在问题，引发了对问责制和建筑业应有道德标准的质疑。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，这些原则应指导建造房屋和社区的每一个方面。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Tung Chung housing project needs further tests'
title.zh: 东涌42区房屋混凝土需进一步检测

summary.en: The Housing Authority (HA) has confirmed that the concrete quality of some structural components in a public housing development project in Tung Chung requires further review and testing. The issue was discovered during routine strength tests, and while the site is deemed structurally safe, additional core sampling...
summary.zh: 房屋委员会（房委会）证实，东涌一个公共房屋发展项目的若干结构构件的混凝土质量需要进一步审查和测试。该问题是在例行强度测试中发现的，尽管该场地被认为结构安全，但已指示进行额外的岩芯取样。

body.en: The Housing Authority (HA) confirmed that the concrete quality of some structural components in a public housing development project in Tung Chung requires further review and testing. In response to media enquiries on Saturday, the authority said the components are in Blocks 3, 4 and 5 of the project in Area 42. The HA said its engineering team discovered the issue during routine concrete cube strength tests conducted between late August and early this month. The Housing Department then led an on-site team in a detailed assessment and confirmed that the site is structurally safe. The authority said the engineering team immediately instructed the contractor to take additional concrete core samples for compressive strength tests to assess whether the concrete strength meets design and contractual requirements. The contractor was also required to submit a detailed report as soon as possible, along with rectification and repair proposals, so that remedial measures could be strictly implemented. The contractor, meanwhile, has replaced the relevant concrete supplier. The Housing Department has instructed other engineering teams to conduct a comprehensive inspection and spot testing of similar site works. So far, no similar problems have been found at other sites. The HA said the target is to complete the project by the original contract completion date, provided that all relevant legislation and structural safety standards are fully complied with. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 房屋委员会（房委会）证实，东涌公营房屋发展项目的部分结构构件的混凝土质量需要进一步审查和测试。当局在周六回应媒体询问时表示，这些组件位于第 42 区项目的第 3、4 和 5 号区块。房委会表示，其工程团队在 8 月底至本月初进行的例行混凝土立方体强度测试中发现了这个问题。房屋署随后率领现场小组进行详细评估，确认该工地结构安全。当局表示，工程团队立即指示承包商额外采集混凝土芯样进行抗压强度测试，以评估混凝土强度是否符合设计和合同要求。并要求承包商尽快提交详细报告以及整改方案，以便严格落实整改措施。与此同时，承包商已经更换了相关的混凝土供应商。房屋署已指示其他工程队对同类工地工程进行全面检查和抽查。截至目前，其他站点尚未发现类似问题。房委会表示，目标是在所有相关法例和结构安全标准得到全面遵守的情况下，在原定合约完成日期前完成该工程。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: When public housing projects face issues with material quality, it raises questions about accountability and the diligence required in serving the community. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to 'execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This reminds us that even in construction, the integrity of the...
reflection.zh: 当公共房屋项目在材料质量上出现问题时，这会引发关于问责制以及服务社区所需勤勉程度的疑问。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁领导者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这提醒我们，即使在建筑工程中，工作的诚信也反映了对居住者福祉的承诺。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: SAR sends 'strongest' tennis squad to Asian Games
title.zh: 港队派出‘最强’阵容征战亚运会

summary.en: Hong Kong, China Tennis Association announced a 12-player squad for the Asian Games, featuring top players Coleman Wong and Eudice Chong, competing in all five tennis disciplines. Association president Michael Cheng described it as one of Hong Kong's strongest-ever Asian Games teams, aiming for medals.
summary.zh: 中国香港网球总会周六宣布了参加本月亚运会的12人阵容，其中包括香港排名最高的球员黄焯明和江迅。总会表示，香港将参加所有五个核心网球项目：男单、女单、男双、女双和混双。总会会长郑 تک生形容这是香港有史以来最强的亚运会阵容之一。他说：“他们已经在世界舞台上证明了自己——现在他们准备争夺奖牌。”

body.en: Hong Kong, China Tennis Association announced on Saturday a 12-player squad for this month’s Asian Games in Nagoya, led by the city’s top-ranked players Coleman Wong and Eudice Chong. The association said Hong Kong will compete in all five core tennis disciplines: men’s singles, women’s singles, men’s doubles, women’s doubles and mixed doubles. Association president Michael Cheng described the lineup as one of the strongest Hong Kong has ever sent to the Asian Games. "They have already proven themselves on the world stage – now they are ready to chase medals," he said. "To every member of Team Hong Kong: go out there, leave everything on the court, and make the whole city roar. Hong Kong is behind you every step of the way." Wong, who recently broke into the ATP top 100, said it is particularly special to return to the Asian Games men’s singles event. "Building on my quarterfinal run in the Hangzhou Asian Games and the experience I’ve gained on the ATP tour and Grand Slams, I'm ready to give everything on the court to deliver the best results for Hong Kong," he said. Chong, who will compete in the women’s doubles with Cody Wong and mixed doubles with Kai Thompson, said representing Hong Kong at the Asian Games again fills her with immense pride. "This year, I have made a major breakthrough in doubles, breaking into the top 60 rankings. I have also competed in three Grand Slams, which has given me greater confidence in handling the pressure at major events," she said. Rising Hong Kong star Kai Thompson, who is making his Asian Games debut, said he believes the experience he gained from competing at the National Games and in the junior Grand Slam will help him build a strong mindset and perform at his best during the competition. The Hong Kong tennis squad will compete at the Games from September 27 to October 3 at Higashiyama Park Tennis Centre in Nagoya. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 中国香港网球协会周六公布了参加本月在名古屋举行的亚运会的 12 名球员名单，由该市排名靠前的球员科尔曼·黄 (Coleman Wong) 和尤迪斯·庄 (Eudice Chong) 领衔。该协会表示，香港将参加所有五个核心网球项目的比赛：男子单打、女子单打、男子双打、女子双打和混合双打。协会主席郑文豪形容这支阵容是香港参加亚运会的最强阵容之一。 “他们已经在世界舞台上证明了自己——现在他们已经准备好追逐奖牌了，”他说。 “致香港队的每一位成员：走出去，把一切都留在球场上，让整个城市欢呼雀跃。每一步，香港都在你们身后。”最近闯入ATP前100名的王说，重返亚运会男单比赛是特别特别的。 “基于我在杭州亚运会四分之一决赛的表现，以及我在ATP巡回赛和大满贯中获得的经验，我已准备好在球场上付出一切，为香港取得最好的成绩，”他说。张将与科迪·黄（Cody Wong）一起参加女双比赛，并与凯·汤普森（Kai Thompson）一起参加混双比赛，她表示再次代表香港参加亚运会让她感到无比自豪。 “今年，我在双打方面取得了重大突破，闯入了前60名。我还参加了三个大满贯比赛，这让我更有信心应对重大赛事的压力。”她说。即将首次亮相亚运会的香港新星汤普森表示，他相信全运会和青少年大满贯比赛中获得的经验将帮助他树立坚强的心态，并在比赛中发挥出最佳水平。香港网球队将于9月27日至10月3日在名古屋东山公园网球中心参加比赛。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The athletes selected for the Asian Games represent Hong Kong with a strong lineup, aiming to achieve success and bring honor to their city. This pursuit of excellence mirrors the Apostle Paul's exhortation to run with all effort, knowing that only one receives the prize, urging dedication in every endeavor. May they compete with integrity and...
reflection.zh: 入选亚运会的运动员代表香港，阵容强大，目标是取得成功并为城市带来荣誉。这种追求卓越的精神，恰似使徒保罗的劝勉，要竭力奔跑，知道只有一人能得奖牌，鼓励我们在每一次的努力中都全力以赴。 愿他们以诚信和体育精神参赛，并铭记真正的胜利不仅在于奖牌，更在于过程中所展现的纪律和品格。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Macau to hold closed-door trial in first national security case against democrat
title.zh: 澳门将在首次国家安全案中对民主派人士进行不公开审判

summary.en: Macau is set to hold its first national security trial next week behind closed doors for a former pro-democracy lawmaker accused of "subversion." This follows an expansion of national security laws in May 2023 and a new bill allowing closed-door hearings in such cases, raising concerns among legal experts and rights...
summary.zh: 澳门法院周五表示，下周将就首起国家安全案件举行不公开审判，被告是一名被控“颠覆罪”的前亲民主议员。此前，中国这个博彩中心于2023年5月扩大了国家安全法的适用范围，并于今年早些时候通过了一项新法案，允许法官在国家安全案件中进行不公开审理。律师和人权组织警告称，此规定可能会破坏政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。

body.en: Macau will hold its first national security trial behind closed doors next week, a court said on Friday, in a case against a former pro-democracy lawmaker charged with “subversion”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San. File photo: Au Kam San, via Facebook. The Chinese casino hub expanded the scope of national security laws in May 2023, and a new bill passed earlier this year allows judges to hear national security cases behind closed doors. Lawyers and rights groups have warned that the rule could undermine the functioning of government departments and apply to “any judicial case”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San in July 2025 became the first person to be arrested under the expanded law, with authorities alleging he had ties to foreign groups endangering China. The judge decided to “hold the trial behind closed doors in order to ensure that national security interests are not compromised”, a statement released by Macau’s final appeals court said. After Au’s arrest, details about the case remained scarce until this July, when judicial authorities in Macau confirmed that he would stand trial as a “principal offender” of subversion and other crimes. The court said the trial decision had been confirmed by Macau’s national security committee, following a request from the city’s public prosecutions office. The proceedings are set to begin September 16. Au, 69, is a primary school teacher who became one of Macau’s longest-serving pro-democracy legislators before deciding not to seek re-election in 2021. Authorities said that a court-appointed lawyer previously accepted by Au will continue to represent him. Macau flag. Photo: gavindeas, via Flickr. Michael Polak, a London-based barrister representing Au, said earlier this year that authorities having “appointed a state lawyer does not remedy the fundamental deficiencies in these proceedings which have all the appearances of a show trial”. “He is a Portuguese national and has been kept incommunicado for one year without access to his family or an independent lawyer,” Polak added. Au’s daughter Cherry said the family is not allowed to visit or communicate with him. “All we ask for is a fair trial, due process, and for his more than three decades of dedication to the people of Macau not to be erased or forgotten,” she said in a statement in July. Under Macau’s security law, subversion offences are subject to a prison term of up to 25 years.
body.zh: 一家法院周五表示，澳门将于下周举行首次国家安全审判，审理一名被控“颠覆国家政权”的前民主派议员的案件。前澳门议员区锦新。资料图：区金山，来自 Facebook。中国赌场中心于 2023 年 5 月扩大了国家安全法的范围，今年早些时候通过的一项新法案允许法官闭门审理国家安全案件。律师和人权组织警告说，该规则可能会损害政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。 2025 年 7 月，前澳门议员区锦新成为根据扩大后的法律被捕的第一人，当局指控他与危害中国的外国组织有联系。澳门终审法院发布的一份声明称，法官决定“闭门审理，以确保国家安全利益不受影响”。区被捕后，有关案件的细节一直很少，直到今年7月，澳门司法当局确认他将作为颠覆国家政权和其他罪行的“主犯”接受审判。法院表示，应澳门检察机关的要求，澳门国家安全委员会确认了审判决定。诉讼程序定于 9 月 16 日开始。区先生现年 69 岁，是一名小学教师，在决定不再寻求 2021 年连任之前，他成为澳门任职时间最长的民主派立法会议员之一。当局表示，区先生之前接受的一名法院指定的律师将继续代表他。澳门旗。照片：gavindeas，来自 Flickr。代表 Au 的驻伦敦大律师迈克尔·波拉克 (Michael Polak) 今年早些时候表示，当局“任命一名国家律师并没有弥补这些诉讼程序中的根本缺陷，这些诉讼程序看起来像是一场表演审判”。波拉克补充说：“他是葡萄牙国民，已被单独监禁一年，无法与家人或独立律师见面。” Au的女儿Cherry表示，家人不被允许探望或与他交流。她在七月的一份声明中表示：“我们所要求的只是公平审判、正当程序，以及他三十多年来对澳门人民的奉献不被抹去或遗忘。”根据澳门国安法，颠覆罪可被判处最高25年监禁。

reflection.en: The news from Macau, where a former lawmaker faces trial behind closed doors for alleged subversion, evokes Proverbs 28:15: "Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor people." The secrecy surrounding the trial raises concerns about justice and the potential for unchecked power to silence dissent, echoing the prophet's warning...
reflection.zh: 澳门前议员因涉嫌“颠覆罪”面临不公开审判的消息，令人联想起《箴言》28章15节：“恶劣的统治者统治贫苦的民众，如同咆哮的狮子或凶猛的熊。”审判的秘密性引发了对公正的担忧，以及不受制约的权力压制异议的可能性，这与先知对压迫性领导的警告不谋而合。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Yu Zidi: China’s fearless swimming prodigy, 13, with Olympics in her sights
title.zh: 余梓迪：中国无畏的游泳天才，13岁，奥运在望

summary.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut...
summary.zh: 余梓迪去年12岁时创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛最年轻的奖牌得主。如今已是青少年，她领衔中国队争夺亚运会霸主地位，并以奥运荣耀为目标。这位13岁的留着精灵短发的在校女生……

body.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. China’s swimmer Yu Zidi prepares for the final of the women’s 200m butterfly swimming event during the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore on July 31, 2025. Photo: Oli Scarff/AFP. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut stunned the sporting world last year with a series of eye-popping times. At the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore she helped China reach the 4x200m women’s freestyle relay final. She did not swim in the final but China came third, earning Yu a historic bronze for swimming in the heats. Yu just missed out on medals in the 200m and 400m individual medley events and the 200m butterfly, coming fourth in all three races. In November at China’s National Games, having just turned 13, she clocked a blistering 2:07.41 in the women’s 200m medley for what was then an Asian record. While training with the China team in Beijing, she told local media this month she was “excited” for her Asian Games debut. “Train well, don’t slack off. Demonstrate the level of your training and work hard to break past yourself,” she said, according to state news agency Xinhua. The Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan open on September 19. Pressure ‘like a stone’ A coach, Ha Sinan, once described Yu with a Chinese saying that translates as “a newborn calf fearless of tigers”. But the teenager has spoken of struggling to deal with the heavy load placed on her. Yu grew up in the city of Baoding, about 150 kilometres (90 miles) south of Beijing. She started swimming aged six and since then has juggled schoolwork with training. “Being in class all day and still having to train was really tiring,” she said in January. “Sometimes I was so tired I could fall asleep even while eating,” she said at an event celebrating Hebei province’s National Games wins. Yu said she “never considered quitting” and always dreamed of being a national champion. But during the tune-up to last year’s National Games she said the pressure of wanting to win the 400m medley nearly became too much. “It was like a big stone that weighed on me and made it hard to breathe,” she said. Yu eventually told her coach she wanted to do anything other than train. Her coach told her to persevere and “believe in yourself”, she said. Yu went on to win four medals at the National Games. Some in the swimming world have questioned the mental and physical impact of high-level training and competing on Yu...
body.zh: 去年，12岁的于紫迪创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛上最年轻的奖牌获得者。如今，十几岁的她成为中国争夺亚运会冠军的头条新闻，并瞄准了奥运会的荣耀。 2025 年 7 月 31 日，在新加坡举行的 2025 年世界游泳锦标赛上，中国游泳运动员于子迪正在备战女子 200 米蝶泳决赛。照片：Oli Scarff/法新社。这位留着精灵发型的 13 岁女学生去年以一系列令人瞠目结舌的成绩震惊了体育界。在2025年新加坡世界游泳锦标赛上，她帮助中国队进入了女子4x200米自由泳接力决赛。她没有参加决赛，但中国队获得了第三名，为余在预赛中获得历史性的铜牌。于刚在200米和400米个人混合泳以及200米蝶泳项目中错失奖牌，在所有三场比赛中均获得第四名。 11月的中国全运会上，刚满13岁的她在女子200米混合泳中取得了惊人的2分07.41秒的成绩，创造了当时的亚洲纪录。在北京与中国队一起训练时，她本月对当地媒体表示，她对自己的亚运首秀感到“兴奋”。据官方通讯社新华社报道，她说：“好好训练，不要懈怠。展示你的训练水平，努力突破自己。”日本爱知名古屋亚运会将于9月19日开幕。压力“如石” 教练哈斯南曾用中国的一句话来形容于玉，“初生牛犊不怕虎”。但这位少女表示，她正在努力应对所承受的沉重负担。于在北京以南约 150 公里（90 英里）的保定市长大。她六岁开始游泳，从那时起她就兼顾学业和训练。 “一整天都在课堂上，而且还要训练，真的很累，”她在一月份说道。 “有时我太累了，连吃饭的时候都能睡着，”她在庆祝河北省全运会胜利的活动中说道。于说她“从未考虑过放弃”，一直梦想着成为全国冠军。但在去年全运会的备战期间，她表示想要赢得 4 亿米混合泳冠军的压力几乎变得太大了。 “这就像一块大石头压在我身上，让我呼吸困难，”她说。于最终告诉她的教练，除了训练之外，她想做任何事情。她说，她的教练告诉她要坚持下去并“相信自己”。于随后在全运会上赢得了四枚奖牌。游泳界的一些人质疑高水平训练和比赛对运动员心理和身体的影响……

reflection.en: At just 13, Yu Zidi is already making waves, aiming for the highest levels of competitive swimming. Her journey embodies the dedication and discipline required to pursue athletic excellence, reminding us of the Apostle Paul's exhortation to run with all our might for the prize that is imperishable. May her youthful ambition inspire perseverance in all...
reflection.zh: 年仅13岁的余梓迪已在泳坛掀起波澜，朝着竞技游泳的最高殿堂迈进。她的旅程体现了追求卓越体育成就所需的奉献和纪律，提醒我们使徒保罗的劝勉：要竭力奔跑，去赢得那永不朽坏的冠冕。 愿她年轻的志向激励我们在所有事业中坚持不懈，无论是在体育、学业还是信仰上，尽我们所能，因为我们知道真正的奖赏超越世俗的赞誉。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: AI could make holiday planning easier for overwhelmed travelers
title.zh: 人工智能可以使旅行计划对不堪重负的旅行者更加轻松

summary.en: New research from the University of Surrey suggests that generative AI can help overwhelmed travelers organize their thoughts, compare options, and complete vacation plans that they might otherwise abandon. The study, published in the Journal of Travel Research, presents a framework based on interviews with UK adults...
summary.zh: 萨里大学的最新研究表明，生成式人工智能可以帮助不堪重负的旅行者整理思绪、比较选项并完成他们可能因此放弃的度假计划。这项发表在《旅游研究杂志》上的研究提出了一个概念框架，该框架基于对使用生成式人工智能规划实际或近期行程的英国成年人的访谈，并说明了人工智能如何通过承担部分协调工作来充当“认知支架”。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Generative AI could help overwhelmed travelers organize their thoughts, compare options and complete vacation plans they might otherwise abandon, according to new research from the University of Surrey.

The study, published in Journal of Travel Research , presents a conceptual framework based on interviews with a group of U.K. adults who had used generative AI to help plan a real or recent trip. The framework shows how AI can act as a form of " cognitive scaffolding ," taking on part of the coordination work while travelers remain in control of their decisions.

The benefits were particularly apparent among travelers who found planning harder to manage. For some, AI turned vacation planning from a task they might delay or give up on into something they felt able to complete.

Dr. Yoonjung Kim, a doctoral researcher in hospitality and tourism management at the University of Surrey and lead author of the study, said, "Planning a vacation involves a series of connected decisions about transport, accommodation, budgets and activities. This can quickly become overwhelming, particularly when travelers are faced with endless information and choices."

"Our research finds that generative AI can provide structure, help people stay focused and make it easier to move forward without taking the final decision out of their hands."

The researchers describe this as a redistribution of mental work rather than its removal. The technology can organize information and keep track of details, freeing travelers to focus their attention on comparing options and making judgments.

Professor Iis Tussyadiah, dean of Surrey Business School and coauthor of the study, said, "For some travelers, generative AI is more than a convenient shortcut. It can make a demanding decision-making process feel manageable and, in some cases, make planning feel possible."

"These findings show how travel technology could become more inclusive by being designed around the different ways people think, plan and make decisions."

The findings point to the potential for more cognitively inclusive travel technology that better accommodates diverse ways of thinking and planning, including support for neurodivergent travelers. The researchers emphasize, however, that the cognitive demands of travel planning can affect any traveler, particularly when a trip involves large amounts of information, multiple constraints and interconnected decisions.

Dr. Bora Kim, associate professor in Surrey Hospitality and Tourism Management and coauthor of the study, said, "The real promise of AI in travel planning is not simply speed or...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 萨里大学的最新研究表明，生成式人工智能可以帮助不知所措的旅行者组织他们的想法，比较选择并完成他们可能会放弃的假期计划。 这项发表在《旅行研究杂志》上的研究提出了一个概念框架，该框架基于对一群使用生成人工智能来帮助计划真实或最近旅行的英国成年人的采访。该框架展示了人工智能如何充当“认知脚手架”的一种形式，承担部分协调工作，同时旅行者仍然控制自己的决定。 对于那些发现计划更难管理的旅行者来说，这种好处尤其明显。对于一些人来说，人工智能将假期计划从他们可能会推迟或放弃的任务变成了他们认为能够完成的任务。 萨里大学酒店和旅游管理博士研究员、该研究的主要作者 Yoonjung Kim 博士表示：“计划假期涉及到一系列有关交通、住宿、预算和活动的相互关联的决策。这很快就会变得令人不知所措，特别是当旅行者面临无穷无尽的信息和选择时。” “我们的研究发现，生成式人工智能可以提供结构，帮助人们保持专注，让他们更容易前进，而无需将最终决定权从他们手中夺走。” 研究人员将其描述为脑力工作的重新分配，而不是消除。该技术可以组织信息并跟踪细节，使旅行者能够将注意力集中在比较选项和做出判断上。 萨里商学院院长、该研究的合著者 Iis Tussyadiah 教授表示：“对于一些旅行者来说，生成式人工智能不仅仅是一条便捷的捷径。它可以让要求严格的决策过程变得易于管理，在某些情况下，让计划变得可能。” “这些发现表明，通过围绕人们思考、计划和决策的不同方式进行设计，旅行技术可以变得更具包容性。” 研究结果表明，旅行技术具有更具认知包容性的潜力，可以更好地适应不同的思维和规划方式，包括为神经分歧的旅行者提供支持。然而，研究人员强调，旅行计划的认知需求可能会影响任何旅行者，特别是当旅行涉及大量信息、多重约束和相互关联的决策时。 萨里酒店和旅游管理学院副教授、该研究的合著者 Bora Kim 博士表示：“人工智能在旅行规划中的真正前景不仅仅是速度或......

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge and the desire to understand the world around us are deeply ingrained in the human spirit. As we develop new tools like generative AI, they can serve as valuable aids in navigating complex tasks, such as planning a much-needed vacation. This technology, when used wisely, can help alleviate the burden of decision-making and allow us...
reflection.zh: 对知识的追求和理解周围世界的渴望深深植根于人类的精神之中。当我们开发出生成式人工智能等新工具时，它们可以成为我们处理复杂任务（如规划一次急需的假期）的宝贵助手。这项技术如果使用得当，可以帮助减轻决策的负担，让我们更好地组织生活和实现愿望。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Five night sky events to look out for this autumn
title.zh: 今秋不容错过的五个夜空奇观

summary.en: From meteor showers to a November supermoon, there are a number of impressive sights to behold in the autumn night sky.
summary.zh: 从流星雨到十一月的超级月亮，秋季夜空中将有许多令人印象深刻的景象。

body.en:
Autumn brings longer nights to the northern hemisphere, offering more opportunities to get outside and look up at the night sky.

There is plenty to look out for over the coming months, from impressive meteor showers to dazzling star clusters.

It will be followed by the impressive Orionid meteor shower in late October, and a planetary parade, the Leonid meteor shower and a supermoon in November.

As the nights lengthen through autumn, one of the most recognisable star clusters in the night sky becomes increasingly prominent.

The Pleiades, also known as the Seven Sisters, is a cluster of young stars around 440 light years from Earth.

Despite its name, most people can see around six stars with the naked eye, although many more become visible through binoculars or a telescope.

Look towards the east during autumn evenings, where the Pleiades can be found in the constellation Taurus.

The Orionid meteor shower is active from early October into November, reaching its peak around 21 October.

Twice each year, Earth passes through trails of dust and debris left behind by Halley's comet. As these tiny particles enter Earth's atmosphere at high speed, they heat up and produce the streaks of light we see as meteors.

The Orionids appear to radiate from the constellation Orion, which gives the shower its name.

For the best chance of seeing them, find somewhere dark and away from artificial lights and allow your eyes time to adjust.

Early risers could be treated to a gathering of Mercury, Venus, Mars and Jupiter around 14 November.

All four planets will be above the horizon before sunrise, although some will be easier to spot than others.

Mercury will be particularly challenging because it remains low in the sky and close to the glare of the rising sun.

Venus and Jupiter, meanwhile, are among the brightest objects in our night sky and should be much easier to pick out.

Another meteor shower arrives later in November, with the Leonids expected to peak around 17 November.

The Leonids can travel at about 70km per second as they enter the Earth's atmosphere, making them some of the fastest meteors visible from Earth.

Under ideal, dark sky conditions, around 10 to 15 Leonids an hour can be visible at the shower's peak, although the actual number seen will depend on weather, light pollution and the brightness of the Moon.

They get their name from the constellation Leo, from which the meteors appear to radiate.

The best time to look is generally after midnight and before dawn, when Leo is higher in the sky.

November's full moon is known as the Beaver Moon. The name is thought to come from the time of year when beavers were particularly active, preparing their lodges and storing food ahead of winter.

A supermoon occurs when a full Moon is relatively...
body.zh: 秋天给北半球带来了更长的夜晚，提供了更多外出仰望夜空的机会。 在接下来的几个月里，从令人印象深刻的流星雨到令人眼花缭乱的星团，有很多值得关注的事情。 随后，十月下旬将迎来令人印象深刻的猎户座流星雨，十一月将举行行星巡游、狮子座流星雨和超级月亮。 随着秋季夜晚的延长，夜空中最容易辨认的星团之一变得越来越突出。 昴宿星团，也称为七姐妹星团，是距离地球约 440 光年的年轻恒星团。 尽管它的名字如此，大多数人都可以用肉眼看到大约六颗恒星，尽管通过双筒望远镜或望远镜可以看到更多的恒星。 秋天的夜晚向东方看，可以在金牛座找到昴宿星团。 猎户座流星雨从10月初到11月都很活跃，在10月21日左右达到顶峰。 地球每年两次穿过哈雷彗星留下的尘埃和碎片痕迹。当这些微小粒子高速进入地球大气层时，它们会升温并产生我们所看到的流星光条纹。 猎户座流星雨似乎是从猎户座辐射出来的，猎户座流星雨因此得名。 为了最好地看到它们，请找到一个黑暗且远离人造光源的地方，让您的眼睛有时间进行调整。 早起的人可能会在 11 月 14 日左右看到水星、金星、火星和木星的聚集。 所有四颗行星都将在日出前出现在地平线以上，尽管有些行星比其他行星更容易被发现。 水星将特别具有挑战性，因为它仍然在天空中很低并且靠近初升太阳的耀眼光芒。 与此同时，金星和木星是夜空中最亮的天体之一，应该更容易辨认出来。 另一场流星雨将于 11 月晚些时候到来，预计狮子座流星雨将在 11 月 17 日左右达到峰值。 狮子座流星雨进入地球大气层时的速度约为每秒 70 公里，使其成为从地球上可见的速度最快的流星之一。 在理想的黑暗天空条件下，在流星雨高峰期每小时可以看到大约 10 到 15 个狮子座流星雨，不过实际看到的数量将取决于天气、光污染和月球的亮度。 它们的名字来源于狮子座，流星似乎是从狮子座辐射出来的。 最佳观测时间通常是午夜之后和黎明之前，此时狮子座在天空中较高的位置。 十一月的满月被称为海狸月。这个名字被认为来自一年中海狸特别活跃的时期，它们在冬天之前准备它们的小屋并储存食物。 当满月相对......时就会发生超级月亮。

reflection.en: As the nights grow longer this autumn, the sky offers a spectacular display of celestial events, from the dazzling Pleiades star cluster to meteor showers and a supermoon. These sights remind us of the vastness and beauty of creation, a silent testament to the glory of its Maker. May these cosmic wonders inspire awe and reflection, drawing our hearts to...
reflection.zh: 随着今秋夜幕渐长，天空将呈现出壮观的天体景象，从耀眼的昴星团到流星雨和超级月亮。这些景象提醒我们造物的浩瀚与美丽，是其创造者荣耀的无声见证。 愿这些宇宙奇观激发敬畏与沉思，引领我们的心去思索那位 orchestrates 天空并呼召我们仰望惊叹的造物主。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Magnetic nanoparticles detect amoxicillin allergy with 98% sensitivity in early tests
title.zh: 磁性纳米颗粒在早期测试中以 98% 的敏感性检测青霉素过敏

summary.en: A multidisciplinary scientific team at the University of Malaga has developed a new technology based on magnetic nanoparticles that enables precise, rapid and reliable diagnosis of allergy to beta-lactam antibiotics, including amoxicillin and other penicillins.
summary.zh: 马拉加大学的一个多学科科学团队开发了一种基于磁性纳米颗粒的新技术，能够精确、快速、可靠地诊断对 β-内酰胺类抗生素（包括阿莫西林和其他青霉素）的过敏。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A multidisciplinary scientific team at the University of Malaga has developed a new technology based on magnetic nanoparticles that enables precise, rapid and reliable diagnosis of allergy to beta-lactam antibiotics, including amoxicillin and other penicillins.

This is a "highly efficient" in vitro diagnostic platform based on 30 nm nanoparticles with an iron oxide core and silica shell, which act "like a tiny magnet covered with thousands of molecular hooks." "If the patient's blood contains the IgE antibodies responsible for the allergy, they are captured much more readily than with conventional methods," explains Ezequiel Pérez-Inestrosa, professor of organic chemistry at the University of Malaga and one of the study's authors.

The journal Materials Today Bio reported the findings of the study, which also involved researchers from the IBIMA BIONAD Platform, the Inflammatory Diseases Network (REI) and the Regional University Hospital of Malaga. Yolanda Vida and María I. Montañez, researchers in the University of Malaga's Department of Organic Chemistry, are the study's lead authors.

"In the tests performed, the system was able to detect virtually all true cases of allergy and reduced both false negatives and false positives," says María José Torres, professor of medicine and another researcher leading the study.

In this regard, Torres notes that penicillin allergy is overdiagnosed. "Although between 8% and 25% of the population report being allergic to these antibiotics, only between 1% and 10% actually are. This incorrect label leads to the use of alternative drugs that are generally less effective, more toxic and contribute to the emergence of bacterial resistance," Pérez-Inestrosa explains. He stresses the importance of identifying these cases safely, as this would make it possible to remove thousands of incorrect diagnoses that affect patients' treatment.

In addition, this new method avoids drug provocation tests with the medication itself, which carry risks for patients, because the analysis can be performed much more simply and rapidly in the laboratory, without lengthy centrifugation procedures.

For this study, blood samples from nearly 100 people were analyzed—50 patients with confirmed amoxicillin allergy and 44 individuals who tolerated these antibiotics. The new technology was also compared with two techniques: ImmunoCAP, the most widely used commercial test, and conventional RAST. Specifically for amoxicillin, the platform achieved 98% sensitivity, whereas ImmunoCAP detected only around 17%.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 马拉加大学的一个多学科科学团队开发了一种基于磁性纳米颗粒的新技术，能够精确、快速和可靠地诊断对 β-内酰胺抗生素（包括阿莫西林和其他青霉素）的过敏。 这是一个“高效”的体外诊断平台，基于具有氧化铁核和二氧化硅壳的 30 nm 纳米粒子，其作用“就像覆盖着数千个分子钩的微小磁铁”。 “如果患者的血液中含有导致过敏的 IgE 抗体，那么它们比传统方法更容易被捕获，”马拉加大学有机化学教授、该研究的作者之一 Ezequiel Pérez-Inestrosa 解释道。 《Materials Today Bio》杂志报道了这项研究的结果，来自 IBIMA BIONAD 平台、炎症性疾病网络 (REI) 和马拉加地区大学医院的研究人员也参与了这项研究。马拉加大学有机化学系的研究人员 Yolanda Vida 和 María I. Montañez 是该研究的主要作者。 “在进行的测试中，该系统能够检测出几乎所有真实的过敏病例，并减少了假阴性和假阳性，”医学教授、另一位领导这项研究的研究员玛丽亚·何塞·托雷斯 (María José Torres) 说。 在这方面，托雷斯指出，青霉素过敏被过度诊断了。 “虽然 8% 到 25% 的人口报告对这些抗生素过敏，但实际上只有 1% 到 10% 的人过敏。这种不正确的标签导致使用替代药物，这些药物通常效果较差、毒性更大，并会导致细菌耐药性的出现，”Pérez-Inestrosa 解释道。他强调安全识别这些病例的重要性，因为这将能够消除数以千计影响患者治疗的错误诊断。 此外，这种新方法避免了对药物本身进行药物激发试验，这会给患者带来风险，因为分析可以在实验室中更简单、更快速地进行，无需冗长的离心程序。 在这项研究中，分析了近 100 人的血液样本，其中 50 名患者确诊对阿莫西林过敏，44 名患者对这些抗生素耐受。该新技术还与两种技术进行了比较：ImmunoCAP（最广泛使用的商业测试）和传统的 RAST。特别是对于阿莫西林，该平台实现了 98% 的灵敏度，而ImmunoCAP 仅检测到 17% 左右。 鉴于这一发现，作者强调需要......

This team's innovation, born from observing and manipulating the physical world, offers a precise diagnostic tool. It reminds us that wisdom and insight can be found when we diligently study the world around us, reflecting the Creator's...
reflection.zh: 通过科学探究追求知识，是理解雅伟创造的精妙运作方式的一种途径。这个团队的创新源于对物理世界的观察和操控，提供了一种精确的诊断工具。它提醒我们，当我们勤奋地研究周围的世界时，就能找到智慧和洞见，这反映了创造主的精妙设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
